EA-14312.name: Exp_VolatilityQuality
EA-14312.summary: This EA trades based on the VolatilityQuality indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions from a downtrend to an uptrend signal and sell positions on the reverse transition. It includes configurable smoothing methods, money management modes, and separate enable/disable switches for buy/sell entry and exit logic.
EA-14312.summary_zh: 该EA基于VolatilityQuality指标进行交易，当指标从下行信号转为上行信号时开多仓，反之时开空仓。它提供可配置的平滑方法、资金管理模式以及买卖入场和出场的独立开关。
EA-14312.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于VolatilityQuality指标的方向性信号变化。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从0变为1时触发买入信号，当从1变为0时触发卖出信号，本质上捕捉动量方向的转换点。出场条件通过独立的买卖平仓开关控制，当反向信号出现时自动平掉对应持仓。仓位管理支持五种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、考虑亏损的自由保证金、考虑亏损的余额以及固定手数。止损和止盈参数分别默认设为1000和2000点，提供了较大的价格波动空间。策略使用多种平滑算法（如LWMA、JJMA、JurX等）对指标进行降噪处理，并通过Filter参数过滤小幅波动信号以减少虚假触发。SignalBar参数允许用户选择使用当前K线或上一根已完成K线的信号，增强了灵活性。
EA-14312.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on directional signal changes from the VolatilityQuality indicator. Entry conditions trigger a buy signal when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 to 1, and a sell signal when it transitions from 1 to 0, essentially capturing momentum direction shifts. Exit conditions are controlled by independent buy/sell close switches, automatically closing the corresponding position when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Stop loss and take profit parameters default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing substantial room for price fluctuation. The strategy employs multiple smoothing algorithms (such as LWMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to denoise the indicator, and uses a Filter parameter to eliminate minor fluctuation signals and reduce false triggers. The SignalBar parameter allows users to choose between the current bar or the last completed bar for signal evaluation, enhancing flexibility.

EA-14314.name: Exp_ColorBears
EA-14314.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBears custom indicator, which uses double-smoothed bearish momentum signals to generate buy and sell entries. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a bearish state (color=2) to neutral (color=0), and sells when transitioning from neutral to bearish. Position sizing and trade management are handled via the TradeAlgorithms library with configurable money management modes.
EA-14314.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorBears进行交易，利用双重平滑的空头动量信号产生买卖入场。当指标从空头状态(颜色=2)转为中性(颜色=0)时开多仓，从中性转为空头时开空仓。仓位管理和交易管理通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种资金管理模式。
EA-14314.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorBears指标的双层平滑动量信号，第一层平滑计算原始熊市力量，第二层平滑对结果进行信号线过滤，产生颜色状态(0=中性,2=空头)用于判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当信号柱颜色从2变为0时视为多头信号开多仓，当颜色从0变为2时视为空头信号开空仓，仅在状态转换时触发交易避免重复入场。出场条件依赖反向信号平仓，同时也设置了固定的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)进行风控。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于净值亏损、基于余额亏损和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1配合固定手数模式使用。策略还提供了买卖开仓和平仓的独立开关，允许用户只启用单向交易或仅平仓不平仓。
EA-14314.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorBears indicator's dual-layer smoothed momentum signals, where the first smoothing layer calculates raw bearish power and the second layer applies a signal line filter to produce color states (0=neutral, 2=bearish) for trend direction judgment. Entry conditions are: when the signal bar color transitions from 2 to 0, it is treated as a bullish signal to open a long position; when the color transitions from 0 to 2, it is treated as a bearish signal to open a short position, with trades triggered only on state transitions to avoid repeated entries. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals for closing positions, while also setting fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, equity loss, balance loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1 combined with a fixed lot mode. The strategy also provides independent switches for buy/sell opening and closing, allowing users to enable only one-directional trading or close-only mode.

EA-14317.name: Exp_ColorBulls
EA-14317.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBulls custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothing algorithm to detect bullish/bearish trend signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral to bullish and sell positions on the reverse transition, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit settings.
EA-14317.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBulls自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑算法检测牛市/熊市趋势信号。当指标从中性转为看涨时开多仓，反向转换时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和止损/止盈设置。
EA-14317.strategy_analysis: 策略基于ColorBulls指标的趋势信号，该指标内部使用了两种平滑方法（第一层和第二层平滑）对价格数据进行处理。入场条件：当指标缓冲区值从0变为2时产生买入信号，从2变为0时产生卖出信号，使用SignalBar参数指定信号所在的K线位置。出场条件通过两个布尔开关控制——BuyPosClose和SellPosClose决定是否在反向信号出现时平仓，同时每笔交易都有固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit点数。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数五种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理还包括偏差参数Deviation_用于控制滑点容忍度，确保在市场波动时订单仍能执行。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪型，在确认趋势方向变化时入场，在反向信号或止盈止损触发时出场。
EA-14317.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on trend signals from the ColorBulls indicator, which internally applies two smoothing methods (first-layer and second-layer smoothing) to process price data. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 to 2, and a sell signal when it transitions from 2 to 0, using the SignalBar parameter to specify the bar index for signal detection. Exit conditions are controlled by two boolean switches — BuyPosClose and SellPosClose determine whether to close positions on reverse signals, while each trade has fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit values in points. Position sizing is implemented through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management also includes a Deviation_ parameter to control slippage tolerance, ensuring orders can still execute during market volatility. The overall strategy is a typical trend-following system, entering when a trend direction change is confirmed and exiting on reverse signals or stop-loss/take-profit triggers.

EA-1433.name: KositBablo10
EA-1433.summary: This EA trades EURUSD using RSI and MA indicators across D1 and H1 timeframes to generate buy and sell signals. It places pending stop orders (BuyStop/SellStop) with fixed TP/SL, and includes a TURBO mode that bypasses existing order checks. The v2 variant adds reversal (turnover) orders and adjusts lot sizing from /2000 to /6500 free margin divisor.
EA-1433.summary_zh: 该EA使用RSI和MA指标在D1和H1周期上为EURUSD生成买卖信号，通过挂止损单（BuyStop/SellStop）入场，设有固定止盈止损。v2版本增加了反转单并调整了仓位计算（自由保证金除数从2000改为6500），TURBO模式可绕过已有持仓检查。
EA-1433.strategy_analysis: 策略基于多周期RSI和MA交叉的动量判断。买入条件：D1 RSI(11/15)<60且H1 RSI(5)<48且H1 MA(20)>MA(2)，此时在Ask上方挂BuyStop单。卖出条件：v1版为D1 RSI(22)>38且H1 RSI(20)>60且H1 MA(23)>MA(12)；v2版简化为H1 RSI(15)>55且H1 MA(23)>MA(2)，在Bid下方挂SellStop单。v2版本额外增加了反转单：买入信号时同时挂SellStop反转单（价格在Bid下方SL-45点），卖出信号时同时挂BuyStop反转单（价格在Ask下方SL+50点），形成对冲。仓位管理根据自由保证金计算，v1除以2000，v2除以6500（更保守），上限15手，下限0.1手，主单用volume/3，反转单用volume/2。出场依赖固定TP=1400点和SL=500点，v2版反转单的TP/SL有所调整。TURBO模式允许在已有持仓时继续下单。
EA-1433.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on multi-timeframe RSI and MA crossover momentum signals. Buy entry: D1 RSI(11/15)<60 AND H1 RSI(5)<48 AND H1 MA(20)>MA(2), then place a BuyStop order above Ask. Sell entry: v1 uses D1 RSI(22)>38 AND H1 RSI(20)>60 AND H1 MA(23)>MA(12); v2 simplifies to H1 RSI(15)>55 AND H1 MA(23)>MA(2), placing a SellStop below Bid. The v2 variant adds reversal (turnover) orders: a SellStop at Bid-(SL-45) points on buy signals, and a BuyStop at Ask-(SL+50) points on sell signals, creating a hedging structure. Position sizing is calculated from free margin divided by 2000 (v1) or 6500 (v2, more conservative), capped at 15 lots with a floor of 0.1 lots; main orders use volume/3, reversal orders use volume/2. Exits rely on fixed TP=1400 pips and SL=500 pips, with adjusted values for reversal orders in v2. TURBO mode bypasses the existing positions/orders check, allowing additional entries even when positions exist.

EA-14344.name: Exp_PA_Oscillator
EA-14344.summary: This EA trades based on the PA_Oscillator custom indicator, which uses two smoothed moving averages with configurable methods and lengths. It opens buy positions when the oscillator transitions from neutral to positive and sell positions when it transitions from neutral to negative, with optional position closing on reverse signals.
EA-14344.summary_zh: 该EA基于PA_Oscillator自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用两条可配置平滑方法和长度的移动平均线。当振荡器从中性转为正值时开多仓，从中性转为负值时开空仓，并可在反向信号时选择平仓。
EA-14344.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是PA_Oscillator指标，它通过对价格数据应用两次平滑算法（第一级和第二级平滑）生成信号。入场条件：当指标缓冲区值从0变为正值（Col[0]>0且Col[1]==0）时开多仓；当指标缓冲区值从2变为小于2（Col[0]<2且Col[1]==2）时开空仓。出场条件：多仓在指标从正值变为0时平仓，空仓在指标从2变为其他值时平仓。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于自由保证金百分比等。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数决定具体的仓位计算方式。策略支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、SMMA、LWMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA），并可在多时间框架上运行，默认为H8周期。入场信号仅在确认新K线时触发，避免重复交易。
EA-14344.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on the PA_Oscillator indicator, which generates signals by applying two smoothing algorithms (first-level and second-level smoothing) to price data. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator buffer transitions from 0 to a positive value (Col[0]>0 and Col[1]==0); a sell position opens when the buffer transitions from 2 to below 2 (Col[0]<2 and Col[1]==2). Exit conditions: long positions close when the indicator shifts from positive to 0, and short positions close when the indicator shifts from 2 to another value. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot size, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for the specific lot calculation method. The strategy supports numerous smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) and can operate on multiple timeframes, defaulting to H8. Entry signals are only triggered upon confirmed new bar formation, preventing duplicate trades.

EA-14346.name: Exp_i-GAP
EA-14346.summary: This EA trades based on the i-GAP custom indicator, which detects price gaps on a specified timeframe. It opens buy positions on upward gaps and sell positions on downward gaps, with configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit. It also supports closing opposite positions when a gap signal is detected in the reverse direction.
EA-14346.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-GAP自定义指标进行交易，该指标用于检测指定时间周期上的价格跳空缺口。当检测到向上缺口时开多仓，向下缺口时开空仓，并支持可配置的仓位大小、止损和止盈。当反向缺口信号出现时，还支持平掉反向持仓。
EA-14346.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是利用价格跳空缺口（GAP）作为交易信号，属于突破类策略。入场条件为：当i-GAP指标在指定信号K线上检测到向上缺口时开多仓，检测到向下缺口时开空仓，缺口大小需超过SizeGAP参数设定的阈值。出场条件包括：固定点数的止损（StopLoss_=1000）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000），以及反向缺口信号触发时平掉对应持仓。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按净值比例等。资金管理参数MM控制仓位比例，默认0.1。该EA还实现了历史回溯检查机制——当开仓和平仓条件同时启用但当前无平仓信号时，会遍历历史K线寻找更早的反向缺口信号以决定是否平仓。新K线检测机制确保信号只在每根K线开始时计算一次，避免重复交易。
EA-14346.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to exploit price gaps as trading signals, classifying it as a breakout-type strategy. Entry conditions are: when the i-GAP indicator detects an upward gap on the specified signal bar, a buy position is opened; when a downward gap is detected, a sell position is opened, with the gap size required to exceed the SizeGAP parameter threshold. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (StopLoss_=1000 points) and take profit (TakeProfit_=2000 points), as well as closing opposite positions when a reverse gap signal is triggered. Position sizing supports multiple modes via the MarginMode enumeration, including fixed lot, balance-proportional, and equity-proportional sizing. The money management parameter MM controls the position ratio, defaulting to 0.1. The EA also implements a historical lookback mechanism — when both opening and closing conditions are enabled but no current close signal exists, it iterates through historical bars to find earlier reverse gap signals to decide whether to close positions. The new bar detection mechanism ensures signals are calculated only once at the start of each bar, preventing duplicate trades.

EA-14358.name: Exp_LeManTrend
EA-14358.summary: This EA trades based on the LeManTrend custom indicator, which uses a dual-line crossover system (Fast and Slow lines). It opens buy positions when the fast line crosses above the slow line and sell positions when the fast line crosses below the slow line, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
EA-14358.summary_zh: 该EA基于LeManTrend自定义指标进行交易，采用快慢线交叉系统。当快线上穿慢线时开多仓，快线下穿慢线时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓，各参数均可配置。
EA-14358.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于LeManTrend指标的双线交叉趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当快线从下方穿越慢线且前一周期快线小于慢线时，产生买入信号；当快线从上方穿越慢线且前一周期快线大于慢线时，产生卖出信号。出场条件分为两种：反向交叉信号触发平仓（可配置开关），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用基于账户保证金的资金管理方式，支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓。指标参数包括最小周期13、中间周期21、最大周期34及EMA平滑周期3，属于典型的斐波那契数列配置。策略缺少移动止损、加仓、减仓等高级仓位管理功能。
EA-14358.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual-line crossover trend following system based on the LeManTrend custom indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the fast line crosses above the slow line from below (previous bar fast < slow, current bar fast > slow), and a sell signal is generated when the fast line crosses below the slow line from above (previous bar fast > slow, current bar fast < slow). Exit conditions include two mechanisms: opposite crossover signals trigger position closing (configurable via BuyPosClose/SellPosClose switches), and fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing uses a margin-based money management system supporting both fixed lot size and margin percentage modes. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries. The indicator parameters include Min=13, Midle=21, Max=34 (Fibonacci sequence) and an EMA smoothing period of 3. The strategy lacks advanced position management features such as trailing stops, scaling in, or partial closing.

EA-14375.name: Exp_LeManTrendHist
EA-14375.summary: This EA trades based on the LeManTrendHist custom indicator, which is a trend-following histogram indicator using multiple smoothed moving averages. It opens buy positions when the histogram rises and sell positions when the histogram falls, with configurable options for entry and exit on each side.
EA-14375.summary_zh: 该EA基于LeManTrendHist自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个使用多重平滑移动平均的趋势跟踪直方图指标。当直方图上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓，并支持对多空方向的入场和出场进行独立配置。
EA-14375.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用LeManTrendHist直方图指标判断趋势方向，指标基于三条不同周期（Min=13, Midle=21, Max=34）的平滑均线计算得出。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（直方图上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（持续上升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（直方图下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]（持续下降）时开空仓。出场条件为：趋势反转时分别平多仓或平空仓，即直方图方向变化时触发对应方向的平仓信号。仓位管理支持五种模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等，通过MM和MMMode参数控制。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000点和2000点，提供了基本的风险控制机制。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只在首次跳价时计算信号，避免重复交易。
EA-14375.strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses the LeManTrendHist histogram indicator to determine trend direction, which is calculated from three smoothed moving averages with different periods (Min=13, Midle=21, Max=34). Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (histogram rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (continued rise); a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (histogram falling) and Value[0]<Value[1] (continued fall). Exit conditions: positions close on trend reversal, meaning a histogram direction change triggers the corresponding close signal for the opposite direction. Position sizing supports five margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage, controlled by the MM and MMMode parameters. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing basic risk control. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only on the first tick of each new bar, preventing repeated trades.

EA-14380.name: Exp_Laguerre_ROC
EA-14380.summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre ROC (Rate of Change) custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions into the upper overbought zone and sell positions when it transitions into the lower oversold zone. It uses a color-state buffer system with values 0-4 to signal momentum shifts, and applies configurable money management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-14380.summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre ROC自定义指标进行交易，当指标转换至上部超买区时开多仓，转换至下部超卖区时开空仓。它使用0-4的颜色状态缓冲系统来发出动量转换信号，并应用可配置的资金管理及止损止盈水平。
EA-14380.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Laguerre ROC指标，这是一种结合了Laguerre滤波器和变动率（ROC）的动量指标。入场条件方面：当指标缓冲值从低于4变为4时，确认上升趋势动量并开多仓；当指标缓冲值从高于0变为0时，确认下降趋势动量并开空仓。出场条件方面：当指标值从高位跌破2时平多仓，当指标值从低位突破2时平空仓，同时设置了固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的两种模式。资金管理方面，EA使用0.1的默认风险比例，并依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的标准函数处理下单逻辑。策略整体上是一种动量跟踪方法，通过Laguerre滤波器平滑价格减少虚假信号，并利用0-4的颜色状态系统提供清晰的信号判定。
EA-14380.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Laguerre ROC indicator, which combines a Laguerre filter with Rate of Change to produce a smoothed momentum oscillator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator buffer value transitions to 4 from below 4, confirming upward momentum; a sell signal is triggered when the buffer transitions to 0 from above 0, confirming downward momentum. Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator value drops below 2, and short positions are closed when it rises above 2, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels as additional safety nets. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot size or margin-based percentage mode via the MMMode enumeration. Money management uses a default 0.1 risk ratio and relies on the standard trading functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh include file. The strategy is fundamentally a momentum-following approach that uses the Laguerre filter to smooth price action and reduce false signals, while the 0-4 color-state buffer system provides unambiguous signal determination.

EA-14383.name: Exp_MACDCandle
EA-14383.summary: This EA trades based on MACD candle color changes using a custom MACDCandle indicator. It opens buy positions when the histogram shifts to bullish (color value 2) and sell positions when it shifts to bearish (color value 0), with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position close logic.
EA-14383.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MACDCandle指标的颜色变化进行交易。当直方图转为看涨颜色（值2）时开多仓，转为看跌颜色（值0）时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和持仓平仓逻辑。
EA-14383.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MACD柱状图的颜色变化来判断市场动量方向转换。入场条件：当MACDCandle指标在信号柱上的颜色值从非2变为2时触发买入信号，从非0变为0时触发卖出信号，且仅在前一柱颜色与当前柱颜色发生方向性转换时才开仓。出场条件通过独立的买入平仓和卖出平仓布尔开关控制，当反向信号出现时平掉对应持仓，同时配合固定点数的止损和止盈进行风险管理。仓位管理采用两种模式：固定手数或基于资金比例的动态计算（通过MMMode参数选择），由MM参数控制资金占比或手数大小。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，具体逻辑封装在库中。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保同一K线柱内不会重复开仓，避免信号重复触发。
EA-14383.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on MACD histogram color changes to detect momentum direction shifts. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the MACDCandle indicator color value at the signal bar changes from non-2 to 2, and a sell signal triggers when it changes from non-0 to 0, requiring a directional transition from the previous bar's color to the current bar's color. Exit conditions are controlled by independent buy-close and sell-close boolean switches, closing corresponding positions when reverse signals appear, combined with fixed stop loss and take profit in points for risk management. Position sizing offers two modes: fixed lot size or dynamic calculation based on margin percentage (selected via MMMode parameter), controlled by the MM parameter for fund ratio or lot size. Money management relies on the externally included TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen, with the detailed logic encapsulated in the library. The strategy also employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure no duplicate entries within the same bar, preventing repeated signal triggers.

EA-14384.strategy_analysis:
分析

### 2.1 核心策略概念
该EA使用**Kalman滤波器**（一种最优递归滤波算法）对OHLC四价格分别进行平滑处理，构建"Kalman蜡烛图"，通过蜡烛图颜色变化（涨/跌/中性）检测趋势转折。

**Kalman滤波器核心算法**：

**创新设计**：将Kalman滤波分别应用于Open/High/Low/Close四价格，构建虚拟蜡烛图，而非仅平滑Close价格。

### 2.2 入场条件
**做多条件**：
1. 前一根K线颜色 ≠ 看涨(2) 且 当前K线颜色 = 看涨(2)
2. 即：从非看涨状态转为看涨状态时入场
3. 同时满足BuyPosOpen开关开启

**做空条件**：
1. 前一根K线颜色 ≠ 看跌(0) 且 当前K线颜色 = 看跌(0)
2. 即：从非看跌状态转为看跌状态时入场
3. 同时满足SellPosOpen开关开启

**颜色编码系统**：
- 颜色0 (DeepPink) = 看跌 (Open > Close)
- 颜色1 (Gray) = 中性 (Open = Close)
- 颜色2 (Blue) = 看涨 (Open < Close)

### 2.3 出场条件
**平多仓**：
- 当前K线颜色转为看跌(0)时
- 满足BuyPosClose开关开启

**平空仓**：
- 当前K线颜色转为看涨(2)时
- 满足SellPosClose开关开启

### 2.4 风险管理
- **止损**: 默认StopLoss=1000点（⚠️过大需优化）
- **止盈**: 默认TakeProfit=2000点（盈亏比2:1良好）
- **手数管理**: 支持LOT/FREEMARGIN/PROFIT/LOSS/LOSSFREEMARGIN 5种模式
- **滑点控制**: Deviation=10点
- **信号时间戳**: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime防止重复交易
- **GlobalVariable清理**: OnDeinit自动清理全局变量

parameters.default_value: 手数（固定手数或风险百分比）

parameters.default_value: 滤波器响应速度（越大越快）

pros: Kalman滤波器算法创新：将最优递归滤波应用于OHLC四价格，比传统MA/SMA更科学
Velocity速度分量：捕捉价格运动方向，比纯价格平滑更敏感
四开关交易控制：BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose独立控制，灵活性高

EA-14392.name: Exp_AnchoredMomentumCandle
EA-14392.summary: This EA trades based on the AnchoredMomentumCandle custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color column value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color column value 0). It uses configurable money management, stop loss, take profit, and separate toggle switches for buy/sell entry and exit logic.
EA-14392.summary_zh: 该EA基于AnchoredMomentumCandle自定义指标进行交易，当指标发出看涨动量信号（颜色列值为2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（颜色列值为0）时开空仓。它具有可配置的资金管理、止损止盈以及独立的买卖入场和出场开关。
EA-14392.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是锚定动量蜡烛指标，通过SMA周期和EMA平滑周期的组合计算动量方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的颜色列值为2（看涨）且前一根柱的值小于2时开多仓，当颜色列值为0（看跌）且前一根柱的值大于0时开空仓。出场条件为：当出现看跌信号时平多仓，当出现看涨信号时平空仓，形成反向信号平仓机制。仓位管理采用自定义的MM参数控制仓位大小，支持固定手数和比例保证金两种模式。资金管理通过止损1000点和止盈2000点来控制单笔风险，止盈是止损的两倍，体现了1:2的风险回报比设计。策略使用新柱检测机制避免同一根K线上重复开仓，仅在新的H4周期柱形成时才重新计算信号。
EA-14392.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the AnchoredMomentumCandle indicator, which calculates momentum direction through a combination of SMA and EMA smoothing periods. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 4's color column value is 2 (bullish) and the previous bar's value is less than 2, while a sell position opens when the color column value is 0 (bearish) and the previous bar's value is greater than 0. Exit conditions: long positions close on bearish signals and short positions close on bullish signals, creating a reverse-signal exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a custom MM parameter to control lot size, supporting both fixed lot and proportional margin modes. Money management controls per-trade risk through a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit, with take profit being double the stop loss, reflecting a 1:2 risk-reward ratio design. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries on the same candle, only recalculating signals when a new H4-period bar forms.

EA-14400.name: Exp_MACD-2
EA-14400.summary: This EA trades based on a custom MACD-2 indicator with three trend detection modes: histogram direction change, cloud (up/down line crossover), and zero-line crossover. It opens buy/sell positions on signal confirmation and closes opposite positions accordingly, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-14400.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MACD-2指标进行交易，支持三种趋势检测模式：直方图方向变化、云图（上下线交叉）和零线穿越。在信号确认时开仓买入/卖出，并同时平仓反向头寸，支持可配置的资金管理和止损/止盈设置。
EA-14400.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义MACD-2指标的三种趋势判断模式。第一种直方图模式（HISTOGRAM）通过检测MACD直方图的方向变化来产生信号——当直方图由下降转为上升时产生买入信号，由上升转为下降时产生卖出信号。第二种云图模式（CLOUD）通过指标的上轨与下轨交叉来判断趋势——当上轨从下方穿越下轨时买入，从上方穿越时卖出。第三种零线模式（ZERO）通过MACD直方图穿越零线来产生信号——从负转正时买入，从正转负时卖出。入场条件要求前一周期与当前周期之间发生方向性变化，确保趋势反转的确认。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及固定止损/止盈。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、亏损自由保证金、亏损余额比例计算，以及固定手数模式。EA仅在新的K线出现时（通过IsNewBar检测）重新计算信号，避免重复开仓。
EA-14400.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on three trend detection modes of the custom MACD-2 indicator. The first histogram mode (HISTOGRAM) generates signals by detecting directional changes in the MACD histogram — a buy signal occurs when the histogram transitions from declining to rising, and a sell signal when it transitions from rising to declining. The second cloud mode (CLOUD) determines trend direction through crossovers of the indicator's upper and lower lines — buying when the upper line crosses above the lower line and selling when it crosses below. The third zero-line mode (ZERO) generates signals when the MACD histogram crosses the zero line — buying on a cross from negative to positive and selling on a cross from positive to negative. Entry conditions require a directional change between the previous and current periods, ensuring confirmation of a trend reversal. Exit conditions include closing on opposite signals and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing supports multiple modes via the MarginMode enumeration, including calculation by free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance percentages, and fixed lot mode. The EA recalculates signals only on new bar appearance (via IsNewBar check), preventing redundant trade entries.

EA-14425.name: Exp_Loco
EA-14425.summary: This EA trades based on the custom Loco indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions from zero to positive and sell positions when it transitions from one to less than one. It supports configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for enabling buy/sell entry and exit signals.
EA-14425.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Loco指标进行交易，当指标从零转为正值时开多仓，从1转为小于1时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理、止损止盈，以及独立的多空开平仓开关。
EA-14425.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于自定义Loco指标的方向信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的前一根值为0且当前值大于0时产生买入信号，当指标缓冲区1的前一根值为1且当前值小于1时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括：买入平仓信号在卖出开仓条件触发时激活，卖出平仓信号在买入开仓条件触发时激活，形成趋势反转即平仓的机制。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式，由MMMode参数选择。资金管理通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数实现固定点数止损止盈，Deviation参数控制滑点容忍度。该策略使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，并在指标数据不足时跳过交易逻辑。
EA-14425.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional signals from the custom Loco indicator for trend-following trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1's previous value is 0 and current value is greater than 0; a sell signal is generated when the previous value is 1 and current value is less than 1. Exit conditions: the buy close signal activates when the sell open condition triggers, and the sell close signal activates when the buy open condition triggers, implementing a trend-reversal exit mechanism. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based modes selected via MMMode. Money management uses fixed-pip stop loss and take profit via StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters, with a Deviation parameter controlling slippage tolerance. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals and skips trading logic when indicator data is insufficient.

EA-1443.name: Exp_Beginner
EA-1443.summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Beginner' indicator, which identifies breakout signals by detecting new fractal-like highs and lows with a configurable offset and period. It opens buy positions when an upward signal appears and sell positions when a downward signal appears, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. The EA includes money management via deposit share or fixed lot sizing, and applies stop loss and take profit to all trades.
EA-1443.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Beginner'指标进行交易，该指标通过检测带有可配置偏移和周期的新分形高低点来识别突破信号。当出现向上信号时开多仓，出现向下信号时开空仓，并可通过参数控制入场和出场权限。EA包含按存款比例或固定手数的资金管理功能，并对所有交易设置止损和止盈。
EA-1443.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Beginner自定义指标，该指标通过检测价格突破前高或前低来产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区出现非空值时产生买入信号，当指标下轨缓冲区出现非空值时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号触发平仓——当检测到买入信号时同时触发空头平仓，检测到卖出信号时触发多头平仓。仓位管理采用MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。EA还通过历史回溯检测最近的交易方向来补充平仓信号，确保在单向持仓模式下也能正确平仓。整体策略属于突破类系统，利用价格突破关键点位产生趋势跟踪信号。
EA-1443.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on the custom Beginner indicator, which generates trading signals by detecting price breakouts of previous highs and lows. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator's upper buffer shows a non-empty value, and a sell signal is triggered when the lower buffer shows a non-empty value. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit settings, plus reverse-signal closing — a buy signal also triggers closing of short positions, and a sell signal triggers closing of long positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation. The EA also performs a historical bar lookup to find the last trading direction for supplementary close signals, ensuring proper position closing even in single-direction holding mode. The overall strategy falls under the breakout category, using price breakouts of key levels to generate trend-following signals.

EA-14433.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBearsGap custom indicator, which detects bearish gap candlestick patterns. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals a bullish reversal from a bearish gap and sell positions when a bearish gap signal persists, with configurable money management and position closing logic.
EA-14433.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBearsGap自定义指标进行交易，该指标检测看跌缺口K线形态。当指标发出从看跌缺口反转的看涨信号时开多仓，当看跌缺口信号持续时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。
EA-14433.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorBearsGap指标识别的看跌缺口K线形态进行交易决策。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从0变为正值时，产生买入信号（Col[1]==0且Col[0]>0）；当指标缓冲区1的值从2变为小于2时，产生卖出信号（Col[1]==2且Col[0]<2）。出场条件包括：买入信号出现时同时平掉卖出仓位，卖出信号出现时同时平掉买入仓位，以及基于固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择资金管理模式。策略使用双重平滑算法对价格进行预处理，第一层平滑和第二层平滑分别可配置不同的平滑方法和周期长度。
EA-14433.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on bearish gap candlestick patterns identified by the ColorBearsGap indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 transitions from 0 to a positive value (Col[1]==0 and Col[0]>0), and a sell signal is generated when buffer 1 transitions from 2 to below 2 (Col[1]==2 and Col[0]<2). Exit conditions include: closing sell positions when a buy signal appears, closing buy positions when a sell signal appears, plus fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels in points. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot size, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for selecting the money management mode. The strategy applies dual smoothing algorithms to preprocess price data, with configurable smoothing methods and period lengths for both the first and second smoothing layers.

EA-14434.name: Exp_ColorBullsGap
EA-14434.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBullsGap custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothing approach to detect bullish momentum gaps. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals upward momentum and sell positions when it signals downward momentum, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
EA-14434.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBullsGap自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用双重平滑方法检测看涨动量缺口。当指标发出向上动量信号时开多仓，发出向下动量信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-14434.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于ColorBullsGap指标的双层平滑算法检测市场动量变化。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从0变为大于0时产生买入信号，当从2变为小于2时产生卖出信号。出场条件通过独立的买入平仓和卖出平仓逻辑实现，与入场信号联动但可分别控制。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制交易规模，MMMode参数决定计算方式。策略仅在出现新K线时执行信号检测（SignalBar为0时除外），避免同一根K线内重复交易。止损和止盈分别固定为1000和2000点，偏差控制在10点以内。
EA-14434.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorBullsGap indicator which employs a dual-layer smoothing algorithm to detect shifts in market momentum. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 transitions from 0 to a value greater than 0, and a sell signal is generated when it transitions from 2 to a value less than 2. Exit conditions are implemented through separate buy-close and sell-close logic, linked to entry signals but independently controllable via input parameters. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of net free margin, percentage of net balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for trade sizing, with MMMode determining the calculation method. The strategy only executes signal detection on new bar formation (unless SignalBar is 0), preventing repeated trades within the same bar. Stop-loss and take-profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with slippage deviation controlled within 10 points.

EA-14452.name: Exp_ColorMETRO_DeMarker
EA-14452.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorMETRO_DeMarker custom indicator, which applies a step-function filter to the DeMarker oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast step line crosses above the slow step line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit settings.
EA-14452.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO_DeMarker自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对DeMarker振荡器应用阶梯函数过滤。当快速阶梯线上穿慢速阶梯线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并提供可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-14452.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorMETRO_DeMarker指标的两条阶梯线交叉信号。该指标将DeMarker振荡器通过快速和慢速步长参数进行阶梯化处理，生成两条离散化曲线。入场条件为：当MPlus线（指标缓冲区0）从下方穿越MMinus线（指标缓冲区1）时，产生买入开仓信号；反之产生卖出开仓信号。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数的固定点数设置，同时当反向交叉信号出现时也会触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易规模，并支持五种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额、固定手数）。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。信号判断使用SignalBar指定的K线索引，默认为前一根已收盘K线，确保信号稳定性。
EA-14452.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from two step-filtered lines of the ColorMETRO_DeMarker indicator. This indicator applies step-function filtering to the DeMarker oscillator using fast and slow step size parameters, producing two discretized curves. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the MPlus line (indicator buffer 0) crosses above the MMinus line (indicator buffer 1), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings in points, while reverse crossover signals also trigger position closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with five money management modes: free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. Signal evaluation uses the SignalBar-specified bar index, defaulting to the last closed bar for signal stability.

EA-14463.name: Exp_ColorMETRO_Stochastic
EA-14463.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_Stochastic custom indicator, which applies step-size filtering to a Stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the Stochastic main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.
EA-14463.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO_Stochastic自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对随机振荡器应用步长过滤。当随机指标主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
EA-14463.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于步长过滤的随机指标(ColorMETRO_Stochastic)的交叉信号交易系统。入场条件：当MPlus线从下方穿越MMinus线时产生买入信号，当MPlus线从上方穿越MMinus线时产生卖出信号，信号确认需要前一根K线上MPlus和MMinus存在明确的大小关系且当前K线发生交叉。出场条件：反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理采用Lot模式直接指定手数，但也支持基于余额、净值等百分比的资金管理模式。信号仅在 新K线 时计算，避免重复交易。步长参数(StepSizeFast=5, StepSizeSlow=15)对随机指标值进行量化过滤，减少虚假信号。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，跟随随机指标的交叉方向入场。
EA-14463.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a crossover signal trading system based on a step-filtered Stochastic oscillator (ColorMETRO_Stochastic). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses above the MMinus line, and a sell signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses below the MMinus line, requiring a clear directional relationship on the previous bar and a crossover on the current bar. Exit conditions: reverse crossover signals trigger position closing, with fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) also configured. Position sizing defaults to direct lot specification (LOT mode), but also supports percentage-based money management modes including balance, free margin, and loss-adjusted variants. Signals are only calculated on new bars via the IsNewBar mechanism, preventing duplicate trades. The step size parameters (StepSizeFast=5, StepSizeSlow=15) quantize the Stochastic values to reduce false signals. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, entering in the direction of Stochastic crossovers.

EA-14475.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iCCI_NR indicator, a double-smoothed CCI with normalized range. EA-14475.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iCCI_NR指标信号进行交易，该指标是经双重平滑的CCI归一化范围指标。当CCI从低位区域向上穿越时开多仓，从高位区域向下穿越时开空仓，并可通过反向信号配置平仓。
EA-14475.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义iCCI_NR指标作为核心信号源，该指标是对CCI进行两次平滑处理后的变体，支持多种平滑算法如SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等。入场条件为：当指标色彩缓冲区值从0状态变化且Col[0]>0时触发买入信号，从4状态变化且Col[0]<4时触发卖出信号。出场条件分为两类：买入平仓在Col[0]>2时触发，卖出平仓在Col[0]<2时触发，且买卖平仓均可通过参数独立开关控制。仓位管理采用五种模式，包括固定手数、按余额百分比、按可用保证金百分比等，由MMMode参数决定。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1表示10%的资金参与度，同时设置了1000点止损和2000点止盈以控制单笔风险。策略还引入了新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线内重复交易，并通过信号时间戳管理交易执行的时序。
EA-14475.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the custom iCCI_NR indicator as its core signal source, which is a double-smoothed variant of CCI supporting multiple smoothing algorithms such as SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, and others. Entry conditions are: a buy signal triggers when the indicator color buffer transitions from state 0 and Col[0]>0, while a sell signal triggers when transitioning from state 4 and Col[0]<4. Exit conditions are split into two types: buy closing triggers when Col[0]>2, and sell closing triggers when Col[0]<2, with both independently controllable via input parameters. Position sizing supports five modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage, determined by the MMMode parameter. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk proportion, defaulting to 0.1 representing 10% capital participation, while setting a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit to control per-trade risk. The strategy also incorporates a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar and manages trade execution timing through signal timestamps.

EA-1448.name: Exp_SuperWoodiesCCI
EA-1448.summary: This EA trades based on the SuperWoodiesCCI custom indicator, which combines a standard CCI and a Turbo CCI to generate momentum-based signals. It opens buy positions when the Turbo CCI crosses above zero from below and sell positions when it crosses below zero from above, while closing opposite positions on signal reversals. The EA includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and multi-timeframe support.
EA-1448.summary_zh: 该EA基于SuperWoodiesCCI自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了标准CCI和Turbo CCI来生成动量信号。当Turbo CCI从零轴下方上穿时开多仓，从零轴上方下穿时开空仓，同时在信号反转时平掉反向仓位。EA包含可配置的资金管理、止损止盈以及多周期支持。
EA-1448.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Woodies CCI系统，使用两个不同周期的CCI指标（标准CCI周期50和Turbo CCI周期10）来判断市场动量方向。入场条件为：当Turbo CCI（指标缓冲区2）当前值大于0且前一个值小于等于0时，产生买入信号；当Turbo CCI当前值小于0且前一个值大于等于0时，产生卖出信号。出场条件包括反向信号平仓和止损止盈平仓两种方式，当出现反向信号时允许平掉当前持仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险回报比为1:2。EA还通过CIsNewBar类进行新K线检测，避免在同一根K线内重复交易。
EA-1448.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Woodies CCI system, using two CCI indicators with different periods (standard CCI period 50 and Turbo CCI period 10) to determine market momentum direction. Entry conditions: when the Turbo CCI (indicator buffer 2) current value is above zero and the previous value is at or below zero, a buy signal is generated; when the current value is below zero and the previous value is at or above zero, a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions include both signal-reversal closing and stop loss/take profit closing, with opposite positions allowed to close when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit percentage-based sizing. Money management relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, with stop loss set at 1000 points, take profit at 2000 points, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The EA also uses the CIsNewBar class for new bar detection to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, and includes a SignalBar parameter that allows signal generation on the current bar (value 0) or confirmed bar (value 1).

EA-14492.name: Exp_Digital_CCI_Woodies
EA-14492.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the Digital CCI Woodies indicator, a doubly-smoothed CCI variant. It opens buy positions when the upper CCI line crosses above the lower CCI line and sell positions on the opposite crossover. Position sizing uses flexible money management modes with configurable stop loss and take profit.
EA-14492.summary_zh: 该EA基于Digital CCI Woodies指标（双重平滑CCI变体）的交叉信号进行交易。当上方CCI线上穿下方CCI线时开多仓，反之开空仓。仓位管理支持多种资金管理模式，并配有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-14492.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Digital CCI Woodies指标的双线交叉系统。指标通过两层平滑处理（MA_Method1/Length1和MA_Method2/Length2）对CCI进行降噪，生成上轨和下轨两条信号线。入场条件为：当上轨线从下方穿越下轨线时产生买入信号，当上轨线从上方穿越下轨线时产生卖出信号，且信号需在SignalBar指定的K线上确认。出场条件分为两部分：一是反向交叉信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose可独立控制），二是固定的止损止盈参数（StopLoss_=1000点，TakeProfit_=2000点）。仓位管理支持四种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于余额(BALANCE)、基于可用保证金(FREEMARGIN)、以及基于扣除浮亏后的保证金(LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE)，通过MM参数控制风险比例。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复触发，同时通过Recount标志在数据不足时自动重试。
EA-14492.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a dual-line crossover system based on the Digital CCI Woodies indicator. The indicator applies two layers of smoothing (MA_Method1/Length1 and MA_Method2/Length2) to reduce CCI noise, generating an upper and lower signal line. Entry conditions: a buy signal occurs when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal occurs when the upper line crosses below the lower line, with confirmation required on the bar specified by SignalBar. Exit conditions are twofold: opposite crossover signals trigger position closing (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose can be independently toggled), and fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels are applied. Position sizing supports four modes: fixed lot (LOT), balance-based (BALANCE), free margin-based (FREEMARGIN), and loss-adjusted margin-based (LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE), controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing repeated triggers, while a Recount flag handles automatic retry when indicator data is insufficient.

EA-14495.name: Exp_ColorMETRO_WPR
EA-14495.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_WPR custom indicator, which is a stepped (metro-style) Williams Percent Range oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast metro line crosses above the slow metro line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable entry/exit switches and basic stop-loss/take-profit management.
EA-14495.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO_WPR自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标是阶梯式威廉百分比范围振荡器。当快速阶梯线上穿慢速阶梯线时开多仓，反之开空仓，具有可配置的入场/出场开关和基本的止损/止盈管理。
EA-14495.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorMETRO_WPR指标的信号线交叉。ColorMETRO_WPR是一个对WPR（威廉百分比范围）指标进行阶梯化处理后的自定义指标，包含快速步长（StepSizeFast）和慢速步长（StepSizeSlow）两条信号线。入场条件为：当MPlus线从下方穿越MMinus线时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号；同时要求前一根K线上两条线的关系确认趋势方向。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数，以及可选的反向信号平仓功能。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理方面提供了四种模式选择，但缺少加仓、减仓或追踪止损等高级资金管理功能。策略在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时才计算信号，避免同一根K线内重复交易。
EA-14495.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of two signal lines from the ColorMETRO_WPR indicator, which applies a step-filter (metro-style) transformation to the Williams Percent Range oscillator. The indicator produces two lines: a fast metro line (MPlus, StepSizeFast=5) and a slow metro line (MMinus, StepSizeSlow=15). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when MPlus crosses above MMinus from below, confirmed by the previous bar showing MPlus below MMinus; a sell signal triggers on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit values in points, with optional reverse-signal closing controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose switches. Position sizing supports multiple modes via the MMMode enum: fixed lot size, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and percentage of free margin minus floating loss. The strategy recalculates signals only on new bar formation or when SignalBar is 0, preventing repeated trades within the same bar. However, there is no trailing stop, break-even, or partial close functionality for advanced money management.

EA-14535.name: StrategyTesterPracticeTrade
EA-14535.summary: This EA enables manual practice trading on the MT5 Strategy Tester by monitoring the Common folder for command text files (buy.txt, sell.txt, close.txt). When a command file is detected, it executes the corresponding trade at the specified lot size. It is designed specifically for strategy tester simulation and not for live trading.
EA-14535.summary_zh: 这个EA通过监控MT5公共文件夹中的命令文本文件(buy.txt, sell.txt, close.txt)来实现策略测试器上的手动练习交易。当检测到命令文件时，它会按照指定手数执行相应交易。该EA专为策略测试器模拟设计，不适用于实盘交易。
EA-14535.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于外部文件触发手动交易信号，属于半自动化交易工具。入场条件是当MT5公共文件夹中出现buy.txt或sell.txt文件时，EA检测到文件后立即执行买入或卖出操作，手数为用户设定的固定手数DLot。出场条件是当检测到close.txt文件时，EA会读取当前持仓的方向和手数，然后以相同手数执行反向交易来平仓。仓位管理非常简单，开仓使用固定手数参数，平仓则读取当前持仓的实际手数进行反向操作。资金管理几乎不存在，没有止损、止盈、追踪止损等任何风险控制机制，也没有资金百分比计算手数的功能。整个策略依赖于外部文件系统的轮询来驱动交易，本质上是一个桥接工具，将外部信号转化为MT5交易指令。
EA-14535.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on external file-triggered manual trading signals, functioning as a semi-automated trading bridge. Entry conditions are triggered when buy.txt or sell.txt files appear in the MT5 Common folder; upon detection, the EA immediately executes a buy or sell order at the user-specified fixed lot size (DLot). Exit conditions are triggered when close.txt is detected; the EA reads the current position direction and volume, then executes a reverse trade with the same volume to close the position. Position sizing is very basic, using a fixed lot size parameter for opening trades and reading the actual position volume for closing trades. Money management is virtually non-existent, with no stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, or any risk control mechanism, nor any percentage-based lot calculation. The entire strategy relies on polling the external file system to drive trades, essentially serving as a bridge tool that converts external signals into MT5 trade instructions.

EA-14546.name: Exp_ColorMETRO_XRSX
EA-14546.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorMETRO_XRSX custom indicator, which combines a double-smoothed METRO step algorithm with XRSX smoothing. It opens buy positions when the fast METRO line crosses above the slow line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
EA-14546.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO_XRSX自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标结合了双平滑METRO步进算法和XRSX平滑。当快速METRO线上穿慢速线时开多仓，反向交叉时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
EA-14546.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorMETRO_XRSX指标的两条缓冲区线条交叉。入场条件为：当MPlus线从下方穿越MMinus线时产生做多信号，当MPlus线从上方穿越MMinus线时产生做空信号。出场条件为：当出现反向交叉信号时，分别平掉多头和空头仓位，这由BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制。仓位管理方面，支持多种模式包括固定手数、基于余额比例、基于可用保证金比例等。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择资金管理模式。EA使用了新柱检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易，同时在指标数据不足时跳过交易逻辑。止损和止盈分别固定为1000和2000点，偏差控制为10点。
EA-14546.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of two buffer lines from the ColorMETRO_XRSX indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses above the MMinus line, and a sell signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses below the MMinus line. Exit conditions: opposite crossover signals trigger closing of long and short positions respectively, controlled by the BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot size, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for selecting the money management mode. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trades on the same bar and skips trading logic when indicator data is insufficient. Stop loss and take profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with a deviation control of 10 points.

EA-1456.name: Exp_TMA
EA-1456.summary: This EA trades breakouts from the TMA (Triangular Moving Average) channel. It opens buy positions when price closes above the upper band by a specified level and sell positions when price closes below the lower band, with configurable stop loss and take profit.
EA-1456.summary_zh: 该EA基于TMA（三角移动平均线）通道突破进行交易。当价格收盘价超过上轨指定点数时开多仓，低于下轨指定点数时开空仓，配有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-1456.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于TMA通道的突破交易。入场条件为：当最新收盘价高于TMA值加上上轨突破点数时产生买入信号，且前一根K线的收盘价未超过该阈值（确认突破刚刚发生）；卖出信号同理，收盘价低于TMA值减去下轨突破点数时触发。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号平仓——买入信号触发时平空仓，卖出信号触发时平多仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算。策略使用多周期框架，指标在H4周期计算而交易在当前周期执行，通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。
EA-1456.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on TMA channel breakout trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the latest close exceeds the TMA value plus the upper breakout level in points, and the previous bar's close was at or below that threshold (confirming a fresh breakout); sell signals are symmetric, triggered when close falls below TMA value minus the lower breakout level. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus counter-signal exits: long positions are closed on sell signals and short positions are closed on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes while positive values represent a share of the deposit. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis with the indicator calculated on H4 while trading executes on the current chart period. The IsNewBar mechanism ensures signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries.

EA-1459.name: Exp_MBKAsctrend3
EA-1459.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MBKAsctrend3 indicator, which combines three weighted Williams Percent Range (WPR) oscillators across different periods to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position sizing based on deposit share or fixed lot size.
EA-1459.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MBKAsctrend3指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标融合了三个不同周期的加权威廉百分比范围（WPR）振荡器来检测动量变化。它在向上动量信号时开多仓，在向下动量信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈以及基于资金份额或固定手数的仓位管理。
EA-1459.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用三个不同周期（9、33、77）的WPR指标的加权组合来判断市场动量方向。入场条件为：当MBKAsctrend3指标的上行信号线在指定K线位置输出非零且非EMPTY_VALUE时，产生买入信号；当下行信号线输出有效值时，产生卖出信号。出场条件分为两层：第一层是反向信号触发平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓）；第二层是当没有反向信号时，通过回溯历史K线查找最近的反向信号来确定平仓方向。仓位管理采用资金百分比模式或固定手数模式，由MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例。资金管理通过止损止盈参数控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体账户风险控制机制。策略还使用了新K线检测机制避免同根K线重复交易。
EA-1459.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core utilizes a weighted combination of three WPR indicators with different periods (9, 33, 77) to determine market momentum direction. Entry conditions: when the MBKAsctrend3 indicator's up-signal buffer outputs a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE at the specified signal bar, a buy signal is generated; when the down-signal buffer outputs a valid value, a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions operate on two levels: first, opposite signals trigger position closure (buy signal closes shorts, sell signal closes longs); second, when no opposite signal appears on the current bar, the EA backscans historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal to determine the closing direction. Position sizing uses either a deposit percentage mode or a fixed lot mode, controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lots and positive values represent deposit share. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks overall account-level risk controls. The strategy also employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trading on the same bar.

EA-1469.name: Exp_ADX_Cross_Hull_Style
EA-1469.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ADX_Cross_Hull_Style indicator for trend direction and the UltraXMA indicator for smoothing-based filtering. It opens buy/sell positions on ADX crossover signals confirmed by UltraXMA trend direction, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit. A simplified version (the underscore file) removes the UltraXMA filter and smoothing parameters, relying solely on the ADX cross signals.
EA-1469.summary_zh: 该EA基于ADX_Cross_Hull_Style指标的趋势方向信号和UltraXMA指标的平滑滤波信号进行交易。在ADX交叉信号被UltraXMA趋势方向确认后开仓做多或做空，支持可配置的仓位管理、止损和止盈。简化版（下划线文件）移除了UltraXMA滤波器和平滑参数，仅依赖ADX交叉信号。
EA-1469.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用ADX_Cross_Hull_Style指标检测趋势方向交叉信号作为主要入场依据，同时用UltraXMA双线（上升线和下降线）的相对位置作为辅助过滤条件。当ADX指标产生上升信号（UpValue非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时，若允许买入则设置BUY_Open为true，若允许平空则设置SELL_Close为true；下降信号同理。UltraXMA的过滤逻辑是：若上升线低于下降线，则取消买入开仓并强制平多；若上升线高于下降线，则取消卖出开仓并强制平空。出场条件包括止损、止盈以及反向信号平仓，还通过历史K线回溯寻找最近一次反向信号来补充平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的标准化交易算法函数，包括滑点偏差控制和信号时间戳防重复下单机制。
EA-1469.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the ADX_Cross_Hull_Style indicator to detect trend direction crossover signals as the primary entry trigger, supplemented by the UltraXMA indicator's dual-line relative position as a filtering condition. When the ADX indicator generates an up signal (UpValue is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE), BUY_Open is set if buying is permitted and SELL_Close is set if short closing is permitted; the same logic applies inversely for down signals. The UltraXMA filter works as follows: if the up line is below the down line, buy opening is cancelled and long closing is forced; if the up line is above the down line, sell opening is cancelled and short closing is forced. Exit conditions include stop loss, take profit, and opposite signal closing, plus a historical bar lookback that searches for the most recent reverse signal to supplement the closing logic. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on standardized trading algorithm functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including slippage deviation control and signal timestamp-based duplicate order prevention.

EA-147.name: Night
EA-147.summary: A night-session trading EA that uses the Stochastic oscillator to identify overbought and oversold conditions, placing buy or sell trades only during a defined night window (21:00–06:00). It features dynamic lot sizing based on free margin and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels with 5-digit broker normalization.
EA-147.summary_zh: 这是一个夜间时段交易EA，利用随机指标识别超买超卖条件，仅在夜间时段（21:00-06:00）执行买入或卖出交易。它具有基于可用保证金动态计算手数的功能，以及固定止损止盈和5位数经纪商归一化处理。
EA-147.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于夜间时段的均值回归思路，利用随机指标在超卖区域（低于30）产生买入信号，在超买区域（高于70）产生卖出信号。入场条件为随机指标前一根K线值穿越超卖/超买阈值，且当前时间处于21:00至06:00的夜间窗口。出场条件依赖固定止损（40点）和止盈（20点），止损大于止盈意味着盈亏比为1:0.5，需要较高胜率才能盈利。仓位管理采用动态手数计算，根据账户可用保证金除以100000再乘以10来确定，并限制在0.1到5手之间。资金管理方面存在缺陷，没有考虑最大回撤限制，且盈亏比不对称，止损是止盈的两倍，单笔亏损可能较大。此外，EA仅在夜间交易，试图利用夜间市场波动较小、均值回归概率较高的特性。
EA-147.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is a mean-reversion approach applied during the night session, using the Stochastic oscillator to generate buy signals when it falls below the oversold level (30) and sell signals when it rises above the overbought level (70). Entry conditions require the Stochastic value of the previous bar to cross the oversold/overbought threshold, and the current hour must be within the 21:00-06:00 night window. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (40 pips) and take-profit (20 pips), meaning the risk-reward ratio is 1:0.5, which requires a high win rate to be profitable. Position sizing uses dynamic lot calculation based on free margin divided by 100,000 multiplied by 10, clamped between 0.1 and 5 lots. Money management has flaws — there is no maximum drawdown limit, and the asymmetric risk-reward ratio means the stop-loss is double the take-profit, so each losing trade erases two winning trades. The EA restricts trading to the night session, attempting to exploit the tendency of lower volatility and higher mean-reversion probability during off-hours.

EA-1480.name: Hawaiian Tsunami Surfer
EA-1480.summary: The Hawaiian Tsunami Surfer EA is a trend-following expert advisor that aims to ride large market waves (tsunamis) by detecting strong directional momentum and entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators to identify high-probability trend continuation setups, with built-in trailing stops to protect profits as the trend progresses.
EA-1480.summary_zh: Hawaiian Tsunami Surfer EA是一个趋势跟踪型专家顾问，旨在通过检测强劲的方向性动量来捕捉大型市场波动（海啸），并沿着主导趋势方向入场交易。它结合移动平均线和动量指标来识别高概率的趋势延续形态，并内置追踪止损以在趋势推进时保护利润。
EA-1480.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是'冲浪'大型趋势波动，类似于冲浪者驾驭海啸巨浪。入场条件基于多重移动平均线的排列确认趋势方向，配合动量指标（如RSI或MACD）验证趋势强度，当短期均线在长期均线之上且动量指标确认向上时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及追踪止损机制，当价格朝有利方向移动时动态调整止损以锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，允许用户自定义风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA提供最大回撤限制和单日最大亏损控制参数，以防止极端行情下的过度损失。整体策略偏向中线持仓，适合在H1或H4等较高时间框架上运行，以过滤市场噪音并捕捉更大的趋势波段。
EA-1480.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to 'surf' large trend waves, analogous to a surfer riding a tsunami. Entry conditions are based on multiple moving average alignments to confirm trend direction, combined with momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) to verify trend strength — going long when the short-term MA is above the long-term MA and momentum confirms upward direction, and vice versa for shorts. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels as well as a trailing stop mechanism that dynamically adjusts the stop as price moves favorably to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a percentage-based calculation relative to account balance, allowing users to customize their risk exposure. In terms of money management, the EA provides maximum drawdown limits and daily loss control parameters to prevent excessive losses during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy leans toward medium-term holding, suitable for running on higher timeframes like H1 or H4 to filter market noise and capture larger trend swings.

EA-1483.name: Exp_ColorCoppock
EA-1483.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorCoppock indicator, which is a momentum-based oscillator derived from Rate of Change values smoothed by a configurable moving average. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from a decline and sell positions when it turns downward from a rise, with configurable permissions for entries and exits.
EA-1483.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorCoppock指标进行交易，该指标是由变化率数值经可配置移动平均平滑后得出的动量振荡器。当直方图从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓，并可配置入场和出场权限。
EA-1483.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Coppock曲线指标，该指标结合了两个不同周期的变化率（ROC）并通过移动平均进行平滑处理，本质上是一种动量反转策略。入场条件为：当OSC[1]<OSC[2]（即前期直方图处于下降趋势）且OSC[0]>OSC[1]（当前值上穿前值）时产生买入信号；反之，当OSC[1]>OSC[2]且OSC[0]<OSC[1]时产生卖出信号。出场条件依靠固定的止损和止盈点数，同时允许通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否在反向信号时平仓。仓位管理使用MM参数，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理方面，MM=-0.1默认表示使用存款的10%作为每笔交易的资金比例。策略在H4周期上运行，属于中长期动量跟踪型交易系统。
EA-1483.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Coppock Curve indicator, which combines two Rate of Change (ROC) values of different periods smoothed by a configurable moving average, essentially functioning as a momentum reversal strategy. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when OSC[1]<OSC[2] (the prior histogram was declining) and OSC[0]>OSC[1] (the current value crosses above the previous), while a sell signal is generated when OSC[1]>OSC[2] and OSC[0]<OSC[1]. Exit conditions rely on fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit values in points, with additional controls via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters to permit closing on reverse signals. Position sizing uses the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management defaults to MM=-0.1, meaning 10% of the deposit is allocated per trade. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe, making it a medium-to-long-term momentum-following trading system.

cons: 止损止盈仅为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
信号逻辑过于简单，仅依赖直方图三值比较，容易产生虚假信号
未包含持仓检查，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H4周期可能过大或不适配所有品种
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are fixed point values without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (ATR)
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially entering under unfavorable conditions
Signal logic is overly simple, relying only on three-value histogram comparison, prone to false signals
No position check before opening, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Default 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP may be too large or unsuitable for all instruments on H4
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自适应调整
添加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在流动性差或点差过大时交易
增加持仓方向检查，避免同向重复开仓
可考虑增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线方向）以过滤逆势信号
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism for self-adaptive adjustment to market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session control to avoid trading during low liquidity or high spread periods
Add position direction check to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Consider adding a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to filter counter-trend signals

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致同向重复开仓，增加风险敞口
固定止损止盈不适配所有品种和波动环境
MM参数负值模式下可能产生过大的固定手数
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause duplicate openings in the same direction, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to all instruments and volatility environments
Negative MM value mode may produce excessively large fixed lot sizes

EA-149.name: ima_expert
EA-149.summary: This EA trades based on the rate of change of a custom iMA indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator's relative change exceeds a threshold and sell positions when it drops below the negative threshold. It employs a trailing stop mechanism for profitable positions and a tick-value-based stop loss for losing ones, with dynamic lot sizing based on risk percentage and a configurable maximum lot cap.
EA-149.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iMA指标的相对变化率进行交易，当指标变化率超过阈值时开多仓，低于负阈值时开空仓。对盈利仓位采用追踪止损，对亏损仓位采用基于tick价值的止损，同时根据风险比例动态计算仓位大小并设有最大手数限制。
EA-149.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自定义移动平均线指标(ima)的相对变化率，通过计算当前值与前一个值的相对差值来衡量趋势动量。入场条件为：无持仓且新K线形成时，若变化率k1大于等于信号阈值k则开多仓，若k1小于等于负k则开空仓。出场条件分为两部分：盈利仓位使用追踪止损，当浮盈点数超过take且当前止损距离也超过take时，将止损上移至当前价格减去take个点（多仓）或当前价格加上take个点（空仓）；亏损仓位则根据浮亏换算为tick点数，若超过drop阈值则强制平仓。仓位管理采用基于风险比例r和止损距离drop的动态手数计算，将自由保证金按风险比例分配后除以每点价值和止损点数，再向下取整至最小手数倍数。资金管理还包含最大手数限制和保证金预检循环递减，确保下单手数不超过账户承受能力。
EA-149.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the relative rate of change of a custom moving average indicator (ima), measuring trend momentum by computing the relative difference between the current and previous indicator values. Entry conditions require no open position and a new bar formation; a buy signal triggers when the rate of change k1 is greater than or equal to the signal threshold k, while a sell signal triggers when k1 is less than or equal to negative k. Exit conditions are split into two parts: profitable positions use a trailing stop that shifts the stop loss when floating profit in points exceeds the take parameter and the current stop distance also exceeds take; losing positions are forcibly closed when the floating loss, converted to tick points, exceeds the drop threshold. Position sizing dynamically calculates lot size based on the risk ratio r and stop loss distance drop, distributing free margin proportionally and dividing by tick value and drop points, then rounding down to the nearest minimum lot increment. Money management also incorporates a maximum lot cap and a margin pre-check loop that decrements the lot size until sufficient free margin is confirmed, ensuring the order size stays within account capacity.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数（盈利保护距离）
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in points (profit protection)

parameters.name: drop
parameters.description: 止损点数（基于tick价值计算的最大亏损）
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points (max loss based on tick value)

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: 信号阈值，指标变化率超过此值触发交易
parameters.description_en: Signal threshold; trade triggers when indicator rate of change exceeds this value

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: 风险比例，用于计算每笔交易的手数
parameters.description_en: Risk ratio used to calculate lot size per trade

parameters.name: max_lots
parameters.description: 最大允许手数，0表示无限制
parameters.description_en: Maximum allowed lot size, 0 means unlimited

pros: 动态仓位管理基于风险比例，每笔交易风险可控
追踪止损机制有效保护已有盈利
新K线检查避免在同一根K线上重复开仓
手数计算包含保证金预检和最大手数限制，防止过度杠杆
使用指标变化率而非价格交叉，能更灵敏地捕捉趋势动量
pros_en: Dynamic position sizing based on risk ratio keeps per-trade risk controlled
Trailing stop mechanism effectively protects existing profits
New bar check prevents repeated entries on the same candle
Lot calculation includes margin pre-check and max lot cap, preventing excessive leverage
Using indicator rate of change rather than price crossover captures trend momentum more sensitively
cons: 依赖自定义指标ima，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行且仅打印警告
追踪止损和止损逻辑互斥，盈利仓位没有硬性止盈目标
信号标志f_buy和f_sell在开仓后通过fdrop()手动清除，但若开仓失败则信号不会重置，可能重复尝试开仓
亏损止损基于浮亏金额换算而非固定点数，在波动率变化时止损距离不稳定
持仓检查仅用PositionSelect按品种选择，多EA同品种运行时可能冲突
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator ima; if the indicator file is missing the EA fails with only a print warning
Trailing stop and stop loss logic are mutually exclusive; profitable positions have no hard take-profit target
Signal flags f_buy and f_sell are manually cleared via fdrop() after open attempt, but if the open fails the signals persist and may cause repeated attempts
Loss stop is based on floating P&L conversion rather than fixed points, making the stop distance unstable under changing volatility
Position check uses PositionSelect by symbol only, which may conflict if multiple EAs run on the same symbol
improvements: 将开仓后信号清除逻辑改为根据交易结果判断，避免开仓失败时信号残留导致重复下单
增加对自定义指标ima的更严格检查和错误处理，包括指标缓冲区数据有效性验证
为亏损仓位添加基于点数的硬性止损，而非仅依赖浮亏金额换算，提高止损的确定性
增加MagicNumber以区分不同EA实例的持仓，避免多EA同品种运行冲突
improvements_en: Change post-open signal clearing logic to check trade result, preventing signal persistence on failed orders
Add stricter validation and error handling for the custom ima indicator, including buffer data validity checks
Add a fixed point-based hard stop loss for losing positions instead of relying solely on floating P&L conversion for more deterministic stops
Add a MagicNumber to distinguish positions from different EA instances, preventing conflicts when multiple EAs run on the same symbol

risk_points: 开仓失败后信号不清除，可能在同一K线反复尝试开仓导致多次滑点损失
止损基于浮亏换算而非固定点数，极端行情下实际止损距离可能远超预期
无MagicNumber管理，多EA同品种运行时持仓和止损逻辑可能互相干扰
追踪止损仅修改止损不设止盈，大幅盈利可能因回调而回吐
risk_points_en: Signals are not cleared on open failure, potentially causing repeated entry attempts on the same bar with slippage accumulation
Stop loss based on P&L conversion rather than fixed points means actual stop distance may far exceed expectations in extreme markets
No MagicNumber management means multiple EAs on the same symbol may interfere with each other's position and stop logic
Trailing stop only modifies stop loss without setting take-profit, meaning significant gains may be given back on pullbacks

EA-14940.name: exp_multic
EA-14940.summary: A multi-currency Martingale-style EA that trades 10 currency pairs simultaneously without any technical indicators. It increases lot size when a position is profitable and reverses direction when a position is losing, closing all positions when overall equity deviates beyond configured thresholds from balance.
EA-14940.summary_zh: 一个多货币对马丁格尔式EA，同时交易10个货币对，不使用任何技术指标。当持仓盈利时增加仓位，当持仓亏损时反转方向，当整体权益偏离余额超过设定阈值时平掉所有仓位。
EA-14940.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是纯价格行为驱动的多货币对交易，不依赖任何技术分析指标。入场条件为：当某货币对没有持仓且可用保证金超过阈值时，按照当前方向（BUY或SELL）以最小手数开仓。出场条件有三个：一是当整体浮亏超过loss参数时全部平仓，二是当整体浮盈超过profit参数时全部平仓，三是当单笔持仓盈利超过minLot*k_closse时单独平仓。仓位管理采用类马丁格尔方法：当持仓盈利超过Lot[i]*k_change时，在相同方向追加minLot手数，同时将Lot[i]递增记录累计仓位。当持仓亏损超过-Lot[i]*k_change时，反转交易方向（Type[i]取反）并平掉当前仓位，下次将以反方向重新开仓。资金管理通过全局equity阈值控制：浮亏超loss或浮盈超profit时一键清仓所有货币对，但没有任何止损止盈设置。
EA-14940.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is purely price-action driven multi-currency trading without any technical analysis indicators. Entry conditions: when a currency pair has no open position and free margin exceeds the threshold, it opens a position at the minimum lot size in the current direction (BUY or SELL). Exit conditions are threefold: first, close all positions when overall floating loss exceeds the loss parameter; second, close all when floating profit exceeds the profit parameter; third, close an individual position when its profit exceeds minLot*k_closse. Position sizing employs a Martingale-like method: when a position's profit exceeds Lot[i]*k_change, it adds minLot lots in the same direction while incrementing Lot[i] to track cumulative size. When a position's loss exceeds -Lot[i]*k_change, it reverses the trading direction (Type[i] flipped) and closes the current position, re-entering in the opposite direction next time. Money management is controlled via global equity thresholds: all positions are liquidated when floating loss exceeds loss or floating profit exceeds profit, but there are no stop-loss or take-profit levels set on any individual trade.

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: 全局浮亏阈值，当余额减权益超过此值时全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Global floating loss threshold; closes all positions when balance minus equity exceeds this value

parameters.name: profit
parameters.description: 全局浮盈阈值，当权益减余额超过此值时全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Global floating profit threshold; closes all positions when equity minus balance exceeds this value

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: 最低可用保证金要求，低于此值不开新仓
parameters.description_en: Minimum free margin required to open a new position

parameters.name: minLot
parameters.description: 最小交易手数，也是加仓和重新开仓的步进单位
parameters.description_en: Minimum trading lot size, also the step size for adding positions and re-entering

parameters.name: k_change
parameters.description: 加仓触发系数，持仓盈利超过Lot[i]*此值时追加仓位
parameters.description_en: Position addition trigger coefficient; adds lot when position profit exceeds Lot[i]*this value

parameters.name: k_closse
parameters.description: 单笔止盈系数，持仓盈利超过minLot*此值时平掉该仓位
parameters.description_en: Individual take-profit coefficient; closes position when profit exceeds minLot*this value

pros: 多货币对分散风险，同时交易10个品种降低单一品种依赖
有全局浮亏和浮盈保护机制，防止极端行情下过度亏损
盈利加仓策略在趋势行情中可以放大收益
pros_en: Multi-currency diversification reduces reliance on any single instrument by trading 10 pairs simultaneously
Global floating loss and profit protection mechanisms prevent excessive drawdowns during extreme market moves
Profit-adding position sizing can amplify returns during trending markets
cons: 类马丁格尔加仓策略在单边亏损行情中会导致仓位越积越大，风险极高
没有任何止损设置，单笔亏损可能无限扩大直到触发全局阈值
反转方向后立即重新开仓没有等待确认，可能在震荡行情中频繁反复亏损
10个货币对同时运行且共用同一个on_trade开关，一个品种触发全局平仓会影响所有品种
编码不规范，变量命名混乱，注释乱码（非UTF-8编码），k_closse拼写错误
cons_en: Martingale-like position adding causes positions to grow increasingly large during sustained losing moves, creating extreme risk
No stop-loss on any individual trade means losses can expand indefinitely until the global threshold triggers
Direction reversal with immediate re-entry lacks confirmation, causing frequent whipsaw losses in ranging markets
10 currency pairs share a single on_trade switch, so one pair triggering global closure affects all positions
Poor coding practices: inconsistent variable naming, garbled comments (non-UTF-8 encoding), and typo in k_closse parameter name
improvements: 为每笔交易设置独立的止损和止盈，不依赖全局阈值作为唯一保护
加入技术指标或趋势过滤器避免在震荡行情中反复反转亏损
将全局平仓开关改为按货币对独立控制，避免单一品种影响全局
improvements_en: Add individual stop-loss and take-profit for each trade instead of relying solely on global equity thresholds for protection
Incorporate technical indicators or trend filters to avoid repeated direction reversals in choppy/ranging markets
Change the global closure switch to per-pair independent control so one pair doesn't trigger closure of all positions

risk_points: 马丁格尔式加仓策略在持续亏损时仓位无限扩大，可能导致爆仓
无单笔止损，完全依赖全局浮亏阈值作为风控，一旦快速跳空可能来不及平仓
方向反转后无等待期无确认机制，震荡市中会产生连续亏损
多品种共用全局开关，一个品种触发清仓导致其他品种被强制平仓
risk_points_en: Martingale-style position adding can cause positions to grow infinitely during sustained losses, potentially leading to margin call
No individual stop-loss means risk control depends entirely on global floating loss threshold, which may fail during fast gap moves
Direction reversal with no wait period or confirmation causes consecutive losses in choppy markets
Multi-pair shared global switch means one pair triggering closure forces all other positions to close

EA-1512.name: PositionsChangeInformer
EA-1512.summary: This EA monitors trade transactions and sends alerts when positions are opened, closed, or reversed. It supports three notification types: popup alerts, sound alerts, and email notifications, with multilingual support via a Translator library.
EA-1512.summary_zh: 该EA监控交易事务，在仓位开仓、平仓或反转时发送提醒。支持三种通知方式：弹窗提醒、声音提醒和邮件通知，并通过Translator库提供多语言支持。
EA-1512.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个仓位变动通知工具。它通过OnTradeTransaction事件监听交易事务，当检测到DEAL_ADD类型的事务时，查询历史成交记录并判断成交类型。入场条件为检测到新的买卖成交，出场条件为检测到平仓成交（包括止损平仓、止盈平仓和普通平仓）。仓位管理方面该EA不涉及任何开仓或平仓操作，仅负责监控和通知。资金管理同样不适用，因为该工具不执行任何交易。策略核心在于通过交易事务回调实时捕获仓位变化，并根据成交评论判断平仓原因（止损或止盈）。
EA-1512.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a position change notification utility. It monitors trade transactions via the OnTradeTransaction event, querying deal history when a DEAL_ADD transaction is detected. Entry conditions correspond to detecting new buy or sell deals, while exit conditions correspond to detecting closing deals including stop loss, take profit, or normal closures. Position sizing is not applicable as the EA does not open or close any positions. Money management is also irrelevant since this tool does not execute trades. The core logic relies on the trade transaction callback to capture position changes in real time, determining closure reasons from deal comments such as stop loss or take profit triggers.

parameters.name: InpAlertType
parameters.description: 提醒类型：弹窗提醒、声音提醒或邮件通知
parameters.description_en: Alert type: popup alert, sound alert, or email notification

parameters.name: InpSoundName

parameters.description: 界面显示语言，通过Translator库实现多语言支持

pros: 实时监控仓位变化，响应迅速，通过OnTradeTransaction回调确保无延迟通知
支持多种提醒方式（弹窗、声音、邮件），适应不同交易场景和用户偏好
多语言支持增加了国际化适用性，方便不同语言用户使用
自动检测邮件功能是否启用并优雅降级为弹窗提醒，具有良好的容错性
能够区分止损平仓、止盈平仓和普通平仓，提供丰富的成交信息
pros_en: Real-time position change monitoring with instant response via OnTradeTransaction callback ensures zero-delay notifications
Supports multiple alert types (popup, sound, email) to accommodate different trading scenarios and user preferences
Multilingual support via Translator library enhances international usability for users across different languages
Graceful degradation from email to popup alerts when email is not enabled, demonstrating good fault tolerance
Distinguishes between stop loss, take profit, and normal closures, providing rich deal information
cons: 仅依赖成交评论字符串来判断止损/止盈平仓，这种方式不可靠，因为评论可能被修改或不包含sl/tp标记
不监控挂单变化，仅监控成交事务，功能覆盖范围有限
邮件发送失败时仅打印错误信息，缺乏重试机制
缺少推送通知支持，无法利用MetaTrader 5的推送功能
Translator库为外部依赖，增加了部署复杂度
cons_en: Relies on deal comment strings to identify stop loss or take profit closures, which is unreliable as comments can be modified or may not contain sl/tp markers
Only monitors deal transactions, not pending order changes, resulting in limited functionality coverage
Only prints error messages on email send failure without any retry mechanism
Lacks push notification support, unable to leverage MetaTrader 5's built-in push notification feature
Translator library is an external dependency, increasing deployment complexity
improvements: 使用DEAL_REASON枚举替代字符串匹配来判断止损/止盈平仓原因，提高可靠性
增加推送通知支持，利用SendNotification函数实现手机端提醒
增加对挂单变化的监控，扩展通知覆盖范围
improvements_en: Use the DEAL_REASON enumeration instead of string matching to determine stop loss or take profit closure reasons for improved reliability
Add push notification support using the SendNotification function for mobile alerts
Extend monitoring to include pending order changes, broadening the notification coverage

risk_points: 依赖字符串匹配判断平仓原因可能导致误判
邮件通知失败后无重试机制可能导致关键信息遗漏
risk_points_en: String matching for closure reason identification may lead to misclassification
No retry mechanism for failed email notifications may cause critical information to be missed

EA-15222.name: Exp_PriceChannel_Stop
EA-15222.summary: This EA trades based on the PriceChannel_Stop indicator, opening buy positions when the upper channel signal triggers and sell positions when the lower channel signal triggers. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and bidirectional trading with independent open/close controls.
EA-15222.summary_zh: 该EA基于PriceChannel_Stop指标信号进行交易，当上轨信号触发时开多仓，下轨信号触发时开空仓。支持多种资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及独立的双向开平仓控制。
EA-15222.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于价格通道（Price Channel）突破的顺势交易系统。入场条件为：当PriceChannel_Stop指标的上轨缓冲区（buffer 3）出现非空信号值时开多仓，当指标的下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现非空信号值时开空仓。出场条件包括：止损和止盈参数硬编码设置，以及反向信号触发平仓——即上轨信号触发时平空仓，下轨信号触发时平多仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数五种模式计算仓位。此外，EA还利用额外的缓冲区（buffer 4和buffer 1）作为辅助平仓信号，当同时允许开仓和平仓时，反向通道信号也会触发平仓。策略仅在指定信号K线（SignalBar）上或新K线形成时检测信号，避免重复交易。
EA-15222.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following breakout system based on the Price Channel indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the PriceChannel_Stop upper channel buffer (buffer 3) produces a non-empty signal value, and a sell position opens when the lower channel buffer (buffer 0) produces a non-empty signal value. Exit conditions include hardcoded stop loss and take profit levels, plus reverse signal closing — the upper channel signal triggers sell position closure while the lower channel signal triggers buy position closure. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Additionally, the EA uses auxiliary buffers (buffer 4 and buffer 1) as secondary exit signals — when both opening and closing are enabled for a direction, the opposite channel signal also triggers position closure. The strategy only checks signals on the specified signal bar (SignalBar) or when a new bar forms, preventing redundant trades.

parameters.description: 资金管理比例，用于计算每笔交易的风险比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio for calculating risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot

parameters.name: ChannelPeriod
parameters.description_en: Calculation period for the price channel

parameters.name: Risk
parameters.description: 通道风险系数，影响通道宽度
parameters.description_en: Channel risk factor affecting channel width

parameters.name: SignalBar
