EA-14972.name: Exp_RVI_Histogram
EA-14972.summary: This EA trades based on the RVI_Histogram custom indicator, supporting two modes: level-based and crossover-based signal generation. It opens buy/sell positions and closes existing ones according to RVI momentum signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-14972.summary_zh: 该EA基于RVI_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，支持两种信号模式：基于水平位和基于交叉。根据RVI动量信号开仓买入/卖出和平仓，并提供可配置的资金管理及止损止盈设置。
EA-14972.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用RVI（相对活力指数）直方图指标作为核心交易信号来源，提供两种趋势判断模式。在水平位模式下，当直方图颜色柱值为0（绿色区域）且Col[0]>0时触发买入信号，当柱值为2（红色区域）且Col[0]<2时触发卖出信号。在交叉模式下，当RVI主线从下方穿越信号线时买入，从上方穿越信号线时卖出。平仓逻辑与开仓相反，买入平仓信号在下降趋势确认时触发，卖出平仓信号在上升趋势确认时触发。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金或固定手数等多种资金管理模式。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，偏离容忍度为10点。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每根K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓。
EA-14972.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the RVI (Relative Vigor Index) Histogram custom indicator as its core trading signal source, offering two trend identification modes. In Levels mode, buy signals trigger when the histogram color bar value is 0 (green zone) and Col[0]>0, while sell signals trigger when the value is 2 (red zone) and Col[0]<2. In Cross mode, a buy signal is generated when the RVI main line crosses above the signal line, and a sell signal when it crosses below. The closing logic mirrors the opening logic: buy positions close on confirmed downtrend signals, and sell positions close on confirmed uptrend signals. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple money management approaches including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot sizing. Stop-loss and take-profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with a slippage tolerance of 10 points. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate position openings.

EA-14980.name: Exp_ColorXMACDCandle
EA-14980.summary: This EA trades based on color changes of the ColorXMACDCandle custom indicator, which is a smoothed MACD histogram displayed as candlesticks. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns bullish and sell positions when it turns bearish, with configurable money management and position control.
EA-14980.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXMACDCandle自定义指标的颜色变化进行交易，该指标是以K线形式显示的平滑MACD直方图。当直方图转为看涨颜色时开多仓，转为看跌颜色时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和仓位控制功能。
EA-14980.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXMACDCandle指标的颜色变化信号，该指标是对传统MACD的增强版本，使用了多种平滑算法（如T3、JJMA等）来减少噪音。入场条件分为两种模式：直方图模式下，当直方图颜色从非2变为2时买入，从非0变为0时卖出；信号线模式下，当信号线颜色从非1变为1时买入，从非2变为2时卖出。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算方式，默认使用固定手数模式。
EA-14980.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on color change signals from the ColorXMACDCandle indicator, which is an enhanced version of the traditional MACD using multiple smoothing algorithms (such as T3, JJMA, etc.) to reduce noise. Entry conditions operate in two modes: in Histogram mode, a buy is triggered when the histogram color changes to 2 from a value less than 2, and a sell when it changes to 0 from a value greater than 0; in SignalLine mode, a buy occurs when the signal line color changes to 1 from a non-1 value, and a sell when it changes to 2 from a non-2 value. Exit conditions rely on opposite signals triggering position closure, combined with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by post-loss free margin percentage, by post-loss balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for the calculation method, defaulting to fixed lot mode.

EA-14981.name: Exp_Stochastic_Histogram
EA-14981.summary: This EA trades based on the Stochastic Histogram indicator, supporting two trend detection modes: level-based and crossover-based. It opens and closes buy/sell positions according to the histogram's signal transitions, with configurable money management and position sizing. The EA operates on a new-bar basis to avoid redundant signal processing.
EA-14981.summary_zh: 该EA基于随机直方图指标进行交易，支持两种趋势判断模式：水平位模式和交叉模式。根据直方图的信号转换来开仓和平仓，具有可配置的资金管理和仓位管理功能。EA以新K线为基础运行，避免重复信号处理。
EA-14981.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义Stochastic_Histogram指标生成交易信号，策略概念基于随机指标的动量变化。入场条件分为两种模式：水平位模式（Levels）下，当直方图颜色从0变为正值时做多，从2变为小于2时做空；交叉模式（Cross）下，当上线穿越下线时做多，当上线跌破下线时做空。出场条件与入场条件对称：做多信号触发时平空仓，做空信号触发时平多仓，同时设置了止损和止盈参数。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持五种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、减损自由保证金、减损余额、固定手数）。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的MarginMode枚举和相应函数实现，允许根据账户状态灵活调整下单手数。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只处理一次信号，避免tick级别重复交易。
EA-14981.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses a custom Stochastic_Histogram indicator to generate trading signals, with the strategy concept based on stochastic momentum changes. Entry conditions are split into two modes: in Levels mode, a buy signal triggers when the histogram color changes from 0 to positive and a sell signal triggers when it changes from 2 to below 2; in Cross mode, a buy signal triggers when the Up line crosses above the Dn line and a sell signal triggers when the Up line crosses below the Dn line. Exit conditions are symmetric to entries: when a buy signal fires, existing sell positions are closed, and when a sell signal fires, existing buy positions are closed, with configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting five money management modes (free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot). Money management is implemented via the MarginMode enum and corresponding functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, allowing flexible lot sizing based on account state. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are processed only once per bar, preventing redundant tick-level trading.

EA-14992.name: BB Automated
EA-14992.summary: This EA places BuyLimit and SellLimit pending orders at the Bollinger Band lower and upper bands respectively on each new M15 candle, and closes open positions when price touches the middle SMA band. It uses no stop loss or take profit, relying entirely on the mean reversion to the Bollinger middle band for exits.
EA-14992.summary_zh: 该EA在每个新的M15K线时在布林带下轨放置BuyLimit挂单，在上轨放置SellLimit挂单，当价格触及布林带中轨SMA时平仓。不设止损和止盈，完全依赖价格回归布林带中轨来退出交易。
EA-14992.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于布林带均值回归概念，假设价格在触及布林带上下轨后会回归中轨。入场条件为：每根新K线形成时，在下轨放置BuyLimit买入限价单，在上轨放置SellLimit卖出限价单。出场条件为：当价格触及布林带中轨SMA时，分别平掉多头和空头仓位。仓位管理采用固定0.01手微型仓位，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面完全没有止损和止盈设置，这意味着如果价格单边运行不回归中轨，亏损将无限扩大。每根新K线会先删除所有未成交挂单再重新下单，避免挂单堆积。但该策略没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓。
EA-14992.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the Bollinger Band mean reversion concept, assuming that price will revert to the middle band after touching the upper or lower bands. Entry conditions: on each new candle, a BuyLimit order is placed at the lower band and a SellLimit order is placed at the upper band. Exit conditions: when price touches the Bollinger SMA middle band, long positions are closed if price is above SMA and short positions are closed if price is below SMA. Position sizing uses a fixed 0.01 micro lot with no dynamic adjustment mechanism. Money management is completely absent of stop loss and take profit, meaning if price trends in one direction without reverting to the middle band, losses can grow unbounded. Each new candle first deletes all pending orders before placing new ones to prevent order accumulation. However, the strategy does not check for existing open positions in the same direction, which could lead to duplicate entries.

EA-15010.name: Exp_CCI_Histogram
EA-15010.summary: This EA trades based on the CCI Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram crosses above the low level from below and sell positions when it crosses below the high level from above. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid repainting.
EA-15010.summary_zh: 该EA基于CCI直方图自定义指标进行交易，当直方图从下方穿越低水平线时开多仓，从上方穿越高水平线时开空仓。它使用可配置的资金管理模式、固定的止损止盈水平，并在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重绘。
EA-15010.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于CCI（商品通道指数）直方图指标的动量反转交易。入场条件为：当CCI直方图的前一信号柱颜色从零值区（Col[1]==0）变为正值（Col[0]>0）时开多仓；当颜色从高值区（Col[1]==2）变为低于2的区域（Col[0]<2）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，同时在反向信号出现时也可平仓（如多仓信号出现时平空仓，空仓信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后可用保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓。指标使用自定义CCI_Histogram指标，通过iCustom调用，支持多时间框架分析。
EA-15010.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum reversal trading based on the CCI (Commodity Channel Index) Histogram indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when the CCI histogram's previous signal bar color transitions from the zero zone (Col[1]==0) to positive (Col[0]>0), and a sell position is opened when it transitions from the high zone (Col[1]==2) to below the high level (Col[0]<2). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings in points, and positions can also be closed on opposing signals (e.g., close sell when buy signal appears, close buy when sell signal appears). Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and the MMMode parameter for calculation method selection. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation happens only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries. The indicator uses a custom CCI_Histogram indicator called via iCustom, supporting multi-timeframe analysis.

EA-15165.name: Exp_Laguerre
EA-15165.summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre indicator's trend signals, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions from state 1 to 2 and sell positions when it transitions from state 2 to 1. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on both sides.
EA-15165.summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre指标的趋势信号进行交易，当指标从状态1转为状态2时开多单，从状态2转为状态1时开空单。它包含可配置的资金管理模式、止损/止盈设置，以及多空双方开仓和平仓的独立控制。
EA-15165.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Laguerre指标作为核心策略信号源，这是一种基于伽马参数的自适应滤波器指标。入场条件为：当Laguerre指标在指定信号K线上的趋势值从1变为2时触发买入信号，从2变为1时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括：止损和止盈分别默认设为1000点和2000点，同时指标反向信号也会触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金、扣除亏损后的余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制交易规模比例，默认为0.1。该策略还加入了新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线内重复交易，并提供了信号K线偏移参数以控制信号延迟。
EA-15165.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Laguerre indicator as its core strategy signal source, which is an adaptive filter indicator based on a gamma parameter. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the Laguerre indicator trend value transitions from 1 to 2 on the specified signal bar, and a sell signal is triggered when it transitions from 2 to 1. Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit set at default 1000 and 2000 points respectively, while opposite indicator signals also trigger position closing. Position sizing supports five margin modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which scales trade size, defaulting to 0.1. The strategy also incorporates a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar, and provides a signal bar offset parameter to control signal latency.

EA-15185.name: Exp_3LineBreak
EA-15185.summary: This EA trades based on the 3 Line Break indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish (0) to bullish (1) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish (1) to bearish (0). It includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for opening and closing positions on each side.
EA-15185.summary_zh: 该EA基于三线反转指标(3LineBreak)进行交易，当指标从0翻转为1时做多，从1翻转为0时做空。支持可配置的资金管理、止损止盈，以及买卖双向的开仓和平仓开关。
EA-15185.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于三线反转(3Line Break)图表指标的趋势翻转信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区2的值从0变为1时产生买入信号并开多仓，从1变为0时产生卖出信号并开空仓。出场条件依赖两个机制：一是趋势反转时自动平掉反向仓位（如买入信号时平空仓），二是趋势延续时如果当前趋势值与前一个值相同则也触发平仓条件。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、减去亏损后的保证金或固定手数四种模式。止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点，风险回报比为1:2。EA还引入了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。偏差参数Deviation_用于控制滑点容忍度。
EA-15185.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on trend reversal signals from the 3 Line Break charting indicator. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 2 transitions from 0 to 1, a buy signal is generated and a long position is opened; when it transitions from 1 to 0, a sell signal is generated and a short position is opened. Exit conditions rely on two mechanisms: first, reverse positions are automatically closed on trend reversal (e.g., closing shorts on a buy signal); second, if the current trend value matches the previous value while both open and close toggles are enabled, the existing position is also flagged for closure. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting four modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot size. The default stop loss is 1000 points and take profit is 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. The Deviation_ parameter controls slippage tolerance during order execution.

EA-15186.name: Exp_ASCtrend
EA-15186.summary: This EA trades based on the ASCtrend custom indicator signals, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop-loss/take-profit, and separate toggles for opening and closing positions on each side.
EA-15186.summary_zh: 该EA基于ASCtrend自定义指标信号进行交易，在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及买卖双向的开仓和平仓独立开关。
EA-15186.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于ASCtrend自定义指标，该指标根据RISK参数计算趋势方向并输出上下信号值。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓信号；当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）产生有效值时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓信号。出场条件分为两种：一是反向信号触发平仓，二是止损止盈触发平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按含浮亏的可用保证金比例、按含浮亏的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算方式。此外，EA在新K线出现时才重新计算信号，避免重复交易，并通过回溯历史柱来检测是否已存在反向信号以决定是否需要平仓。
EA-15186.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the ASCtrend custom indicator, which calculates trend direction based on the RISK parameter and outputs upward and downward signal values. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, it triggers buy-open and sell-close signals; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a valid value, it triggers sell-open and buy-close signals. Exit conditions come in two forms: reverse signal triggers position closure, and stop-loss/take-profit levels trigger closure. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by free margin including floating loss, by balance including floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for calculation method. Additionally, the EA only recalculates signals on new bars to avoid repeated trades, and it looks back through historical bars to check for existing reverse signals to determine if position closing is warranted.

EA-15187.name: Exp_BykovTrend
EA-15187.summary: This EA trades based on the BykovTrend custom indicator, which generates up/down arrow signals using WPR (Williams Percent Range) logic. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, with configurable position closing and money management options.
EA-15187.summary_zh: 该EA基于BykovTrend自定义指标进行交易，该指标利用WPR（威廉百分比范围）逻辑生成上下箭头信号。在上涨信号时开多仓，下跌信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
EA-15187.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于BykovTrend指标的趋势信号，该指标内部使用WPR（威廉百分比范围）和RISK/SSP参数来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标上轨（UpValue）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非空值时开多仓，当下轨（DnValue）出现有效信号时开空仓。出场条件分为信号反向平仓和止损/止盈平仓两种：当出现反向信号时如果启用了相应平仓选项则平掉对应仓位，同时使用固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit参数进行止损止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的自由保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式，但该EA没有动态调整仓位大小的自适应机制，且缺少对价差（spread）的过滤。
EA-15187.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on trend signals from the BykovTrend indicator, which internally uses WPR (Williams Percent Range) with RISK and SSP parameters to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when the lower buffer (DnValue) produces a valid signal. Exit conditions include two mechanisms: signal-based closing where reverse signals trigger position closure if the corresponding close option is enabled, and fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit levels. The EA also performs a historical bar scan to detect prior close signals when both open and close flags are enabled but no close signal was found on the current bar. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for calculation mode, but the EA lacks adaptive position sizing and does not filter for spread.

EA-15188.name: Exp_Candles_Smoothed
EA-15188.summary: This EA trades based on the Candles_Smoothed custom indicator, which smooths candlestick data using one of ten selectable smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the smoothed trend value transitions from 0 to 1 and sell positions when it transitions from 1 to 0, with configurable position sizing based on a margin percentage and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-15188.summary_zh: 该EA基于Candles_Smoothed自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用十种可选平滑算法之一对K线数据进行平滑处理。当平滑趋势值从0变为1时开多仓，从1变为0时开空仓，仓位大小基于保证金百分比计算，并使用固定的止损止盈水平。
EA-15188.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于平滑后的K线指标判断趋势方向，通过趋势值的0/1状态切换产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4在SignalBar位置的趋势值从0变为1时开多仓，从1变为0时开空仓。出场条件包括：固定止损和止盈（StopLoss_=1000点，TakeProfit_=2000点），以及趋势反转时的反向平仓信号。仓位管理采用基于保证金比例的动态手数计算（MM=0.1，即使用可用保证金的10%），通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数执行。资金管理方面，MM参数控制每笔交易占用保证金的比例，止损1000点、止盈2000点的风险收益比为1:2。该策略还支持独立控制买卖方向的开仓和平仓，允许只做多头或只做空头，具有一定的灵活性。
EA-15188.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the smoothed candlestick indicator to determine trend direction, generating trade signals through 0/1 state transitions of the trend value. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 at the SignalBar position transitions from 0 to 1, a buy position is opened; when it transitions from 1 to 0, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit (StopLoss_=1000 points, TakeProfit_=2000 points), as well as reverse close signals on trend reversal. Position sizing uses margin-percentage-based dynamic lot calculation (MM=0.1, meaning 10% of available margin), executed through BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. Money management uses the MM parameter to control the percentage of margin used per trade, with a risk-reward ratio of 1:2 from the 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit. The strategy also supports independent control of buy/sell direction for both opening and closing, allowing long-only or short-only configurations with some flexibility.

EA-15189.name: Exp_FiboCandles
EA-15189.summary: This EA trades based on the FiboCandles custom indicator, which uses Fibonacci ratio levels to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the trend turns bullish and sell positions when the trend turns bearish, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The EA only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant entries.
EA-15189.summary_zh: 该EA基于FiboCandles自定义指标进行交易，利用斐波那契比率水平生成趋势信号。当趋势转为看涨时开多仓，趋势转为看跌时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。EA仅在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复入场。
EA-15189.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于FiboCandles指标的趋势跟踪，该指标内部使用斐波那契回撤比率（0.236、0.382、0.500、0.618、0.762）来分析K线并判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值从0变为1时产生买入信号并同时平空仓，当值从1变为0时产生卖出信号并同时平多仓。出场条件包括固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号触发时的平仓操作。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额、以及固定手数。EA还引入了IsNewBar机制来限制信号检测频率，仅在新的K线形成时才重新计算信号，避免在同一根K线内重复交易。此外，当同时允许开仓和平仓时，如果前一根K线的趋势值与当前方向一致，还会额外触发平仓信号，起到趋势反转确认的保护作用。
EA-15189.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the FiboCandles indicator, which internally uses Fibonacci retracement ratios (0.236, 0.382, 0.500, 0.618, 0.762) to analyze candles and determine trend direction. Entry conditions are: when indicator buffer 4 changes from 0 to 1, a buy signal is generated and existing sell positions are closed; when it changes from 1 to 0, a sell signal is generated and existing buy positions are closed. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), as well as position closing triggered by opposing trend signals. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin minus floating loss, based on balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to limit signal detection frequency, only recalculating signals when a new bar forms, which prevents redundant trading within the same bar. Additionally, when both opening and closing are enabled, if the previous bar's trend value aligns with the current direction, an extra close signal is triggered, serving as a protective confirmation for trend reversals.

EA-15190.name: Exp_Go
EA-15190.summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Go' indicator's trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from downtrend to uptrend, and sell positions when it transitions from uptrend to downtrend, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15190.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Go'指标的趋势方向变化进行交易。当指标从下降趋势转为上升趋势时开多仓，从上升趋势转为下降趋势时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-15190.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义指标'Go'判断趋势方向，指标返回值1代表上升趋势，2代表下降趋势。入场条件为：当指标在SignalBar上从2变为1时触发买入信号，从1变为2时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（如买入信号出现时平空头），以及止损止盈退出。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持五种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。额外逻辑中，当同时允许开仓和平仓时，持续趋势也会触发平仓信号，起到跟踪止损的作用。
EA-15190.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the custom 'Go' indicator to determine trend direction, where indicator value 1 represents an uptrend and 2 represents a downtrend. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator transitions from 2 to 1 on the SignalBar, and a sell signal triggers when it transitions from 1 to 2. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals (e.g., closing shorts when a buy signal appears) and stop loss/take profit exits. Position sizing supports five modes via the MMMode parameter, including fixed lots, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. EA-15214.name: Exp_Heiken_Ashi_Smoothed
EA-15214.summary: This EA trades based on trend reversal signals from the Heiken Ashi Smoothed custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the trend shifts from bearish (0) to bullish (1) and sell positions on the opposite transition, using buffer index 4 of the indicator. Position sizing and trade execution are handled via the TradeAlgorithms library with configurable money management modes.
EA-15214.summary_zh: 该EA基于Heiken Ashi Smoothed自定义指标的趋势反转信号进行交易。当趋势从空头(0)转为多头(1)时开多仓，反之开空仓，使用指标的第4个缓冲区。仓位管理和交易执行通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种资金管理模式。
EA-15214.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Heiken Ashi Smoothed指标判断趋势方向的反转。入场条件为：当指标第4缓冲区（趋势值）从0变为1时，产生买入信号并开多仓，同时可平空仓；当趋势值从1变为0时，产生卖出信号并开空仓，同时可平多仓。出场条件包括：趋势反转时的对向平仓信号、固定的止损和止盈设置（默认1000和2000点）。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms库的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，支持基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金或固定手数等多种资金管理模式。指标支持多种平滑方法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等），长度和相位参数可调，提供了灵活的趋势平滑能力。信号基于SignalBar指定的K线位置计算，默认为前一根已收盘的K线（值=1），避免未收盘K线的信号不稳定问题。EA还包含新K线检测逻辑，确保同一根K线上不会重复开仓，同时在趋势持续时允许同向持仓的平仓操作。
EA-15214.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the Heiken Ashi Smoothed indicator to detect trend direction reversals. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 (trend value) changes from 0 to 1, a buy signal is generated to open a long position and optionally close shorts; when it changes from 1 to 0, a sell signal opens a short position and optionally closes longs. Exit conditions include counter-trend close signals on reversal, plus fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing is handled through the TradeAlgorithms library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions, supporting multiple money management modes including free margin-based, balance-based, post-loss margin-based, and fixed lot sizing. The indicator supports multiple smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) with adjustable length and phase parameters, providing flexible trend smoothing capabilities. Signals are calculated based on the bar specified by SignalBar (default=1, the last closed bar), avoiding instability from unclosed bars. The EA includes new bar detection logic via the CIsNewBar class to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar, and also allows same-direction position closes when the trend persists with both open and close flags enabled.

EA-15215.name: Exp_Karacatica
EA-15215.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Karacatica indicator, which uses ATR to generate up and down momentum signals. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The EA supports both entry and exit signals independently, allowing flexible position management.
EA-15215.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Karacatica指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标使用ATR生成上涨和下跌动量信号。在上涨信号时开多仓，下跌信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。EA支持独立的入场和出场信号控制，允许灵活的仓位管理。
EA-15215.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于Karacatica自定义指标产生的动量信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上产生非空值时开多仓，当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）产生非空值时开空仓。出场条件为：上涨信号同时触发空仓平仓，下跌信号同时触发多仓平仓，此外还额外回溯历史K线寻找更早的反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的五种模式实现，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金和余额等多种模式计算仓位大小。EA使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，并通过BarsCalculated检查确保指标数据就绪后再进行交易逻辑判断。
EA-15215.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on momentum signals generated by the custom Karacatica indicator, which uses ATR with a configurable period to identify trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the upper buffer (buffer 1) of the Karacatica indicator produces a non-empty, non-zero value on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces such a value. Exit conditions: an up signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a down signal triggers closing of buy positions; additionally, the EA performs a historical bar-by-bar lookback to find earlier opposing signals for close decisions when both open and close permissions are enabled. Position sizing is handled through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library offering five modes including fixed lot size, balance percentage, free margin percentage, and loss-adjusted variants of margin and balance. Money management supports multiple calculation methods based on free margin, balance, free margin minus floating loss, and balance minus floating loss. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism via CIsNewBar class to prevent repeated trades within the same bar, and checks BarsCalculated to ensure indicator data readiness before executing trading logic.

EA-15219.name: Exp_LeManSignal
EA-15219.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom LeManSignal indicator, opening buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals. It includes configurable buy/sell opening and closing logic, with optional stop-loss and take-profit levels, plus money management via a percentage-based lot sizing parameter (MM). The EA also handles conflicting signals by canceling both entries when simultaneous buy and sell signals occur.
EA-15219.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义LeManSignal指标的信号进行交易，在上涨动量信号时开多单，在下跌动量信号时开空单。它包含可配置的买入/卖出开仓和平仓逻辑，以及可选的止损和止盈水平，并通过百分比仓位管理参数(MM)进行资金管理。当同时出现买入和卖出信号时，EA会取消两个入场信号以避免冲突。
EA-15219.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于LeManSignal自定义指标产生的动量信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当指标上轨(UpValue)出现非零且非空值时产生买入信号，当指标下轨(DnValue)出现非零且非空值时产生卖出信号。出场条件有两种：一是通过反向信号平仓（买入信号触发卖出平仓，卖出信号触发买入平仓），二是通过固定点数的止损和止盈平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示按账户余额百分比计算手数，正值表示固定手数。资金管理方面，EA包含冲突信号处理逻辑——当同时出现买入和卖出信号时，所有开仓和平仓标志都会被重置为false，避免同时开多空仓。此外，当买入开仓和买入平仓同时启用（或卖出同理）但未检测到平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来确定平仓条件，这是一种保守的风险控制机制。
EA-15219.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on momentum signals generated by the custom LeManSignal indicator for trend-following trading. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) shows a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE reading, while a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (DnValue) shows a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE reading. Exit conditions come in two forms: closing via opposing signals (a buy signal triggers sell position closure, and vice versa), or through fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where a negative value calculates lot size as a percentage of account balance, and a positive value represents a fixed lot size. For money management, the EA includes a conflict resolution mechanism — when both buy and sell signals appear simultaneously, all open and close flags are reset to false, preventing contradictory positions. Additionally, when both buy-open and buy-close (or sell equivalents) are enabled but no close signal is detected on the signal bar, the EA loops back through historical bars to find the most recent opposing signal to determine the close condition, which serves as a conservative risk control mechanism.

EA-15221.name: Exp_NonLagDot
EA-15221.summary: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the NonLagDot custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator shifts from downtrend (2) to uptrend (1) and sell positions on the opposite transition, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit.
EA-15221.summary_zh: 该EA基于NonLagDot自定义指标检测的趋势反转进行交易。当指标从下降趋势(2)转为上升趋势(1)时开多仓，反向转换时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理、止损和止盈。
EA-15221.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于NonLagDot指标的趋势反转跟踪策略。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从2变为1时产生买入信号，从1变为2时产生卖出信号，即检测趋势方向的切换。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（如持多仓时出现卖出信号）、止损和止盈触发平仓。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持五种模式：固定手数、按余额比例、按净值比例、按亏损后余额比例和按亏损后净值比例。资金管理参数MM控制仓位大小，默认0.1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。同时在同一方向上，如果既允许开仓又允许平仓且当前处于该趋势中，也会生成平仓信号，起到部分趋势跟踪中的出场辅助作用。
EA-15221.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a trend reversal following system based on the NonLagDot custom indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 value transitions from 2 to 1 (downtrend to uptrend), and a sell signal when it transitions from 1 to 2 (uptrend to downtrend). Exit conditions include: closing on opposing signal reversal (e.g., closing a long when a sell signal appears), stop loss at 1000 points, and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing supports five margin modes via the MarginMode enum: fixed lot, balance-based percentage, free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and loss-adjusted free margin percentage. The MM parameter defaults to 0.1, controlling position size proportion. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries. Additionally, when both open and close permissions are enabled for the same direction and the current trend matches, a close signal is also generated, serving as an auxiliary exit mechanism within the trend-following logic.

EA-15224.name: panel_for_trade
EA-15224.summary: This is a semi-automated trade panel EA that provides a GUI interface on the chart for manually placing BUY and SELL orders, closing positions, and adjusting lot size via plus/minus buttons. It displays live bid/ask prices and allows one-click trade execution without any automated strategy logic.
EA-15224.summary_zh: 这是一个半自动交易面板EA，在图表上提供GUI界面，用于手动下单买入和卖出、平仓以及通过加减按钮调整手数。它显示实时买价/卖价，允许一键执行交易，但不包含任何自动化策略逻辑。
EA-15224.strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个图形化交易面板工具，而非基于策略信号的自动化交易系统。入场条件完全依赖交易者手动点击BUY或SELL按钮，EA只是将当前市价作为入场价格提交订单。出场条件同样依赖手动操作，交易者需点击CLOSE按钮来平仓，没有任何自动止损或止盈机制。仓位管理通过面板上的加减按钮调整手数，默认手数为0.01，每次增减0.01手，最小手数限制为0.01。资金管理方面完全缺失，没有风险控制、没有最大持仓限制、没有账户余额检查。该EA还提供了当前买价和卖价的实时显示，交易者可以直观地看到市场价格并据此决定交易方向。
EA-15224.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is essentially a graphical trade panel utility rather than an automated strategy-based trading system. Entry conditions rely entirely on the trader manually clicking BUY or SELL buttons, with the EA simply submitting market orders at the current bid/ask price. Exit conditions are also purely manual, requiring the trader to click the CLOSE button to close positions, with no automatic stop-loss or take-profit mechanism whatsoever. Position sizing is managed through plus/minus buttons on the panel, defaulting to 0.01 lots with 0.01 increments and a minimum of 0.01 lots. Money management is completely absent, with no risk controls, maximum position limits, or account balance checks. The EA does provide real-time display of current bid and ask prices, allowing traders to see market prices visually and decide on trade direction accordingly.

EA-15227.name: Exp_Sidus
EA-15227.summary: This EA trades based on the Sidus indicator, which uses dual EMA and dual LWMA crossovers to generate buy and sell signals. It opens and closes positions systematically on new bar signals with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels.
EA-15227.summary_zh: 该EA基于Sidus指标进行交易，该指标利用双EMA和双LWMA交叉产生买入和卖出信号。它在新的K线信号上系统地开仓和平仓，具有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈水平。
EA-15227.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Sidus指标，通过快速EMA与慢速EMA的交叉以及快速LWMA与慢速LWMA的交叉来确认趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区0（UpValue）有非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的信号时，开多单并平空单；当缓冲区1（DnValue）有信号时，开空单并平多单。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设置，以及反向信号触发时的平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持固定手数、按余额百分比和按可用保证金百分比等多种模式。资金管理还包含了对买卖仓位独立控制的开仓和平仓开关，允许灵活配置交易方向。此外，EA在新K线形成时才计算信号，避免重复交易，但在同时允许开仓和平仓时，会向前回溯历史K线确认是否已有反向平仓信号。
EA-15227.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Sidus indicator, which confirms trend direction through the crossover of a fast EMA with a slow EMA and a fast LWMA with a slow LWMA. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 0 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE signal, a buy position is opened and sell positions are closed; when buffer 1 (DnValue) signals, a sell position is opened and buy positions are closed. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closure triggered by opposing signals. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting fixed lot size, balance percentage, and free margin percentage modes. Money management also features independent buy/sell open and close switches, allowing flexible directional trading configuration. Additionally, the EA only calculates signals on new bar formation to avoid repeated trades, and when both open and close permissions are enabled, it retrospectively scans historical bars to confirm whether an opposing close signal already exists.

EA-15228.name: Exp_SilverTrend
EA-15228.summary: This EA trades based on the SilverTrend_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on reverse signals. The strategy operates on a new-bar basis to avoid redundant signals within the same bar.
EA-15228.summary_zh: 该EA基于SilverTrend_Signal自定义指标进行交易，在向上信号时开多仓，在向下信号时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈以及反向信号时可选的平仓功能。策略以新K线为基础运行，避免同一K线内重复触发信号。
EA-15228.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用SilverTrend_Signal指标作为唯一的信号源，该指标基于价格突破高低点来生成趋势信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定K线上产生非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时开多仓，当下行信号缓冲区（buffer 0）产生信号时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设置，以及当开启反向平仓功能时，在收到反向信号后平掉当前持仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的自由保证金和基于扣除亏损后的余额。EA还实现了一个额外的回溯逻辑：当同时允许开仓和平仓但当前未触发平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓，以避免在趋势中途开仓而未平掉反向持仓。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式，整体设计偏保守但缺乏对滑点和市场流动性的特别处理。
EA-15228.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the SilverTrend_Signal indicator as its sole signal source, which generates trend signals based on price breakouts of recent highs and lows. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's up-signal buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when the down-signal buffer (buffer 0) produces a signal. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit levels, as well as optional reverse-signal closing when the corresponding buy/sell close flags are enabled. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, margin-based on free margin, margin-based on balance, margin-based on loss-adjusted free margin, and margin-based on loss-adjusted balance. The EA also implements a lookback logic: when both open and close permissions are enabled but no close signal is triggered on the current signal bar, it scans forward through historical bars to find the nearest reverse signal, ensuring that a reverse position is closed before opening a new one. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for calculation mode, but the design lacks special handling for slippage and market liquidity constraints.

EA-15234.name: Exp_Stalin
EA-15234.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom 'Stalin' indicator, which combines fast/slow moving averages and RSI to generate buy/sell signals. It opens and closes positions based on up/down arrow signals from the indicator, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
EA-15234.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Stalin'指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标结合快慢移动平均线和RSI来产生买卖信号。它根据指标的上下箭头信号开仓和平仓，并提供可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
EA-15234.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义Stalin指标生成交易信号，该指标内部结合了快速EMA（周期14）和慢速EMA（周期21）以及RSI（周期17）来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标上箭头缓冲区非零且非空值时做多，当指标下箭头缓冲区非零且非空值时做空。出场条件分为两种：一是止损止盈触发出场，二是反向信号触发平仓——即当持仓方向出现反向指标信号时关闭对应仓位。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，包含BuyPositionOpen、SellPositionOpen、BuyPositionClose、SellPositionClose四个核心交易函数。此外，EA在新K线形成时或需要重新计算时才更新信号，避免逐tick重复计算，但反向信号确认逻辑会遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓，这在一定程度上增加了逻辑复杂度。
EA-15234.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the custom Stalin indicator to generate trading signals, which internally combines a fast EMA (period 14) and a slow EMA (period 21) along with RSI (period 17) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the indicator's up-arrow buffer is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE; a sell is triggered when the down-arrow buffer is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE. Exit conditions are twofold: first, stop loss and take profit levels trigger exits; second, opposing signals trigger position closure — when an opposing indicator signal appears, the corresponding position is closed. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by loss-adjusted free margin, by loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is implemented through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, utilizing four core trading functions: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, and SellPositionClose. Additionally, the EA only updates signals on new bar formation or when recalculation is needed, avoiding per-tick redundant computation. However, the reverse signal confirmation logic iterates through historical bars to find the nearest opposing signal for close decisions, which adds some logical complexity.

EA-15237.name: Exp_StepMA_NRTR
EA-15237.summary: This EA trades based on the StepMA_NRTR custom indicator, which is a step-moving average NRTR (No Repaint Trailing Reverse) system. It opens buy positions on upward step signals and sell positions on downward step signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. Positions are managed per-bar using new bar detection to avoid redundant signals.
EA-15237.summary_zh: 该EA基于StepMA_NRTR自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一种阶梯移动平均NRTR（无重绘追踪反转）系统。在向上阶梯信号时开多仓，向下阶梯信号时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。通过新K线检测机制逐 bar 管理持仓，避免重复信号。
EA-15237.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于StepMA_NRTR指标的趋势跟踪信号进行交易，该指标结合了阶梯移动平均线和NRTR追踪止损逻辑。入场条件为：当指标的上行通道缓冲区（buffer 2）出现非空值时开多仓，当指标的下行通道缓冲区（buffer 3）出现非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（多仓在下行信号时平仓，空仓在上行信号时平仓），以及止损和止盈的硬性退出。仓位管理通过MarginMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比和基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理参数MM控制每笔交易的风险比例，默认为0.1。策略还包含一个额外的确认逻辑：在主信号判断之后，还会检查指标的趋势线缓冲区（buffer 0和1），如果趋势线也发出反向信号，则增强平仓决策。信号仅在每根新K线时评估一次，避免同一根K线内重复开仓。
EA-15237.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy trades based on trend-following signals from the StepMA_NRTR indicator, which combines a step-moving average with NRTR (No Repaint Trailing Reverse) logic. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upper channel buffer (buffer 2) shows a non-empty value, and a sell position is opened when the lower channel buffer (buffer 3) shows a non-empty value. Exit conditions include closing on reverse signals (buy close on down signal, sell close on up signal), plus hard stop loss and take profit exits. Position sizing supports multiple modes via the MarginMode enum, including fixed lot size, percentage of balance, and percentage of free margin. The money management parameter MM controls the risk ratio per trade, defaulting to 0.1. An additional confirmation logic checks the trend line buffers (buffers 0 and 1) after the primary signal, reinforcing close decisions if the trend line also signals a reversal. Signals are evaluated only once per new bar via the CIsNewBar class, preventing redundant entries within the same bar.

EA-15239.name: Exp_SuperTrend
EA-15239.summary: This EA trades based on the SuperTrend indicator, which combines CCI and ATR to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the SuperTrend signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable position closing on signal reversals. The EA supports multiple money management modes and includes fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-15239.summary_zh: 该EA基于SuperTrend指标进行交易，该指标结合CCI和ATR来判断趋势方向。当SuperTrend发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。EA支持多种资金管理模式，并包含固定的止损和止盈水平。
EA-15239.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用SuperTrend指标作为核心策略，SuperTrend结合CCI（商品通道指数）和ATR（平均真实范围）来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当SuperTrend指标的上轨信号线（buffer 2）在指定信号K线上有有效值时，开多仓并平空仓；当下轨信号线（buffer 3）有有效值时，开空仓并平多仓。出场条件包括两种方式：一是通过反向信号触发平仓（如上升趋势信号出现时平空仓），二是通过固定点数的止损和止盈。此外，EA还检查指标的主线（buffer 0和1）来确认平仓信号，增加了额外的出场过滤。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于可用保证金减亏损、基于余额减亏损，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。信号延迟通过SignalBar参数控制，默认为1即使用上一根完成的K线。
EA-15239.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the SuperTrend indicator as its core strategy, which combines CCI (Commodity Channel Index) and ATR (Average True Range) to identify trend direction. Entry conditions are: when the SuperTrend upper signal line (buffer 2) has a valid value on the specified signal bar, it opens a buy position and closes any sell position; when the lower signal line (buffer 3) has a valid value, it opens a sell position and closes any buy position. Exit conditions include two methods: first, reverse signal triggers position closure (e.g., sell positions close when an uptrend signal appears), and second, fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points. Additionally, the EA checks the indicator's main lines (buffers 0 and 1) to confirm close signals, adding an extra exit filter. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus loss, balance minus loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. Signal delay is controlled by the SignalBar parameter, defaulting to 1 which uses the last completed bar.

EA-15240.name: Exp_WPRSIsignal
EA-15240.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom WPRSIsignal indicator, which combines WPR (Williams Percent Range) and RSI to generate buy/sell entry signals. It opens and closes positions systematically based on indicator buffer values, with configurable money management and position sizing modes.
EA-15240.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义WPRSIsignal指标的信号进行交易，该指标结合了WPR（威廉指标）和RSI来生成买卖入场信号。它根据指标缓冲区值系统地开仓和平仓，并提供可配置的资金管理和仓位规模模式。
EA-15240.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用WPRSIsignal自定义指标产生动量交易信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上输出非零且非EMPTY_VALUE时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓信号；当缓冲区0（DnValue）输出非零且非EMPTY_VALUE时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置（默认1000和2000点），以及指标反向信号的平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的自由保证金和基于扣除亏损后的余额。EA还实现了新K棒检测机制，避免在同一K棒内重复交易，并在信号缺失时回溯历史K棒寻找反向信号以决定是否平仓。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。
EA-15240.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses momentum signals generated by the custom WPRSIsignal indicator, which combines Williams Percent Range and RSI. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) outputs a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, it triggers a buy open and sell close signal; when buffer 0 (DnValue) outputs a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE, it triggers a sell open and buy close signal. Exit conditions include hardcoded stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus indicator-based reverse signal closing logic. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, based on free margin, based on balance, based on loss-deducted free margin, and based on loss-deducted balance. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trades within the same bar and retrospectively searches historical bars for reverse signals to decide whether to close positions when current bar signals are absent. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1.

EA-15241.name: panel-joke
EA-15241.summary: This EA is a semi-automated trading panel that generates buy/sell signals based on a simple multi-price comparison momentum heuristic across Open, High, Low, Close prices. It provides a graphical interface with manual Buy/Sell/Close buttons and an autopilot mode that automatically executes trades when the signal bias exceeds the opposing direction. The strategy compares the last two bars' price components to count directional votes, displaying the result as percentage bars on the chart.
EA-15241.summary_zh: 该EA是一个半自动交易面板，基于简单的多价格比较动量启发式方法生成买卖信号。它提供图形界面，包含手动买入/卖出/平仓按钮，以及一个自动驾驶模式，当信号偏向超过对方时自动执行交易。策略通过比较最近两根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价等来统计方向投票数，并将结果显示为百分比条。
EA-15241.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多重价格分量动量投票：比较最近两根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价以及它们的组合均值，共7个维度进行方向性判断。入场条件为：当买入信号数大于卖出信号数时做多，反之做空；在自动驾驶模式下，如果当前无持仓则开新仓，如果持有反向仓位则先平仓再反转。出场条件仅在自动驾驶模式下通过反向信号触发平仓和反手，手动模式下仅能通过面板的CLOSE按钮平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数0.01，没有任何递增或递减逻辑。资金管理完全缺失，没有止损和止盈设置，所有交易的SL和TP均为0，存在无限亏损风险。
EA-15241.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a multi-price-component momentum voting system: it compares the last two bars across Open, High, Low, Close and their derived averages (7 dimensions total) to determine directional bias. Entry conditions: when buy signals exceed sell signals, a long position is opened; when sell signals exceed buy signals, a short is opened. In autopilot mode, if no position exists a new one is opened; if an opposing position exists, it is closed first and then reversed. Exit conditions are only triggered in autopilot mode via opposing signal reversal, or manually via the CLOSE button on the panel. Position sizing uses a fixed lot of 0.01 with no scaling logic whatsoever. Money management is entirely absent — all trades are opened with SL=0 and TP=0, creating unlimited loss exposure.

EA-15245.name: Exp_NRTR
EA-15245.summary: This EA trades based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggle controls for opening and closing positions on both sides. The strategy follows trend reversals detected by the NRTR indicator's trailing stop mechanism.
EA-15245.summary_zh: 该EA基于NRTR（Nick Rypock追踪反转）指标进行交易，在上涨信号时开多仓，在下跌信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及买卖双方向的开仓和平仓独立开关控制。策略跟随NRTR指标追踪止损机制检测到的趋势反转信号。
EA-15245.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用NRTR指标的追踪止损反转信号进行趋势跟踪交易。NRTR指标通过动态调整止损线来识别趋势方向变化，当指标的上行信号线（buffer 2）出现非空值时产生买入信号，当指标的下行信号线（buffer 3）出现非空值时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：在指定信号K线上，NRTR指标对应方向信号线返回有效值即触发开仓。出场条件包括：止损/止盈触发、反向信号平仓（如买入信号触发时平掉卖仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、按余额比例、按净值比例、按可用保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例计算。此外，EA还通过buffer 0和buffer 1读取NRTR的止损线，当允许同方向开仓和平仓时，止损线触及也会触发平仓。整个策略仅在新K线形成时或首次计算时才执行信号检测，避免了逐tick重复交易的问题。
EA-15245.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the NRTR indicator's trailing stop reversal signals for trend-following trading. The NRTR indicator identifies trend direction changes by dynamically adjusting its trailing stop line. An upward signal line (buffer 2) returning a non-empty, non-zero value generates a buy signal, while a downward signal line (buffer 3) returning a non-empty, non-zero value generates a sell signal. Entry conditions: on the specified signal bar, when the NRTR indicator's corresponding directional signal line returns a valid value, a position is opened. Exit conditions include: stop loss/take profit triggers, reverse signal closing (e.g., a buy signal closes sell positions). Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based percentage, equity-based percentage, free margin-based percentage, and loss-adjusted balance percentage. Additionally, the EA reads the NRTR stop lines from buffers 0 and 1, which can also trigger position closing when both opening and closing in the same direction are enabled. The strategy only evaluates signals on new bar formation or during the initial calculation, avoiding redundant per-tick trading decisions.

EA-15248.name: Exp_NRTR_extr
EA-15248.summary: This EA trades based on the NRTR_extr (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse Extended) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable position closing logic. It uses a money management system with multiple margin modes and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. The strategy follows trend reversals detected by the NRTR indicator with additional confirmation from the indicator's trend lines.
EA-15248.summary_zh: 该EA基于NRTR_extr自定义指标进行交易，在向上信号时开多仓，向下信号时开空仓，并具有可配置的平仓逻辑。它使用多种保证金模式的资金管理系统和固定的止损/止盈水平。策略遵循NRTR指标检测到的趋势反转，并结合指标趋势线进行额外确认。
EA-15248.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于NRTR_extr指标的趋势跟踪反转交易。入场条件为：当指标的第2个缓冲区（UpValue）在指定信号K线上有有效值时，开多仓并平空仓；当第3个缓冲区（DnValue）有有效值时，开空仓并平多仓。此外，EA还通过第0和第1个缓冲区进行额外的趋势确认，用于更精确的平仓判断——如果同向趋势仍在延续，则不执行平仓操作。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数，以及指标的反转信号平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后的可用保证金比例、按扣除亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例或固定手数。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并通过Recount标志处理指标数据未就绪的情况。
EA-15248.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend-following reversal trading based on the NRTR_extr indicator. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 2 (UpValue) has a valid value on the specified signal bar, a buy position is opened and sell positions are closed; when buffer 3 (DnValue) has a valid value, a sell position is opened and buy positions are closed. Additionally, the EA uses buffers 0 and 1 for trend confirmation to refine exit decisions — if the trend in the same direction is still continuing, the closing signal is suppressed. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit points, as well as indicator reversal signals for position closing. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus losses, percentage of balance minus losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk percentage or fixed lot. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, and employs a Recount flag to handle cases where indicator data is not yet ready.

EA-15262.name: Exp_Elliott_Wave_Oscillator
EA-15262.summary: This EA trades based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator (EWO), which is the difference between two smoothed moving averages. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit.
EA-15262.summary_zh: 该EA基于艾略特波浪振荡器(EWO)进行交易，EWO是两条平滑移动平均线的差值。当振荡器从下降状态转为上升时开多仓，从上升状态转为下降时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈。
EA-15262.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于艾略特波浪振荡器，即两条不同周期平滑移动平均线的差值，用于识别动量方向变化。入场条件：当EWO值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当EWO值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件：开多仓信号同时触发平空仓，开空仓信号同时触发平多仓，另外设置了固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金等。该EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免逐tick重复交易，同时在初始化时验证指标句柄有效性并计算最小所需历史数据量。
EA-15262.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator, which calculates the difference between two smoothed moving averages of different periods to identify momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the EWO turns upward from a declining state (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position is opened when the EWO turns downward from a rising state (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions: the buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and the sell signal simultaneously triggers closing of buy positions, with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, including fixed lot size, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based calculation. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing repeated tick-level trading. During initialization, it validates the indicator handle and calculates the minimum required historical data bars before allowing any trading activity.

EA-15294.name: Exp_XDPO_Histogram
EA-15294.summary: This EA trades based on the XDPO_Histogram custom indicator, which is a Detrended Price Oscillator variant smoothed with configurable algorithms. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional position closing on reverse signals. The strategy uses multi-timeframe analysis with configurable smoothing methods and money management modes.
EA-15294.summary_zh: 该EA基于XDPO_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，该指标是经过可配置平滑算法处理的去趋势价格振荡器变体。当直方图向上反转时开多仓，向下反转时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。策略支持多周期分析，可配置平滑方法和资金管理模式。
EA-15294.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于XDPO（去趋势价格振荡器）直方图指标的动量反转信号。入场条件：当直方图前一根柱值小于前两根柱值（下降趋势中），且最新值大于前一根值（出现向上反转）时开多仓；反之，当直方图前一根柱值大于前两根柱值（上升趋势中），且最新值小于前一根值（出现向下反转）时开空仓。出场条件：可通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数启用反向信号平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持四种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后保证金比例、固定手数。指标采用双重平滑处理，第一层平滑用于计算去趋势价格，第二层平滑用于信号生成，支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等多种平滑算法。策略默认在H4周期运行，属于中长期动量反转交易系统。
EA-15294.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on momentum reversal signals from the XDPO (Detrended Price Oscillator) histogram indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the histogram's previous bar value is less than the bar before it (downtrend) and the latest value exceeds the previous bar (upward reversal); conversely, a sell position opens when the previous bar exceeds the one before it (uptrend) and the latest value drops below the previous bar (downward reversal). Exit conditions: reverse-signal closing is optional via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters, with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports four modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of margin after losses, and fixed lot size. The indicator uses dual smoothing: the first smoothing layer calculates the detrended price, and the second smoothing layer generates signals, supporting multiple algorithms including SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, and AMA. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe and operates as a medium-to-long-term momentum reversal trading system.

EA-15304.name: Exp_ColorXdinMA_StDev
EA-15304.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorXdinMA_StDev custom indicator, which combines a double-length moving average (XdinMA) with standard deviation channels. It supports three signal modes (point, direct, without) for both entry and exit, and includes money management with multiple margin modes.
EA-15304.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorXdinMA_StDev的信号进行交易，该指标结合了双长度移动平均线(XdinMA)和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点状、直接、无信号）用于入场和出场，并包含多种保证金模式的资金管理功能。
EA-15304.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于ColorXdinMA_StDev指标的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件分为三种模式：点状模式（POINT）通过检测指标缓冲区中的非空值信号点来触发买卖；直接模式（DIRECT）通过检测移动平均线的拐点（V形反转）来判断趋势变化；无信号模式（WITHOUT）则禁用对应方向的交易。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可以基于卖出信号点或MA线下降来判断，卖出平仓反之。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种保证金模式包括固定手数、基于余额和可用保证金的比例计算等。EA使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。止损和止盈分别固定设置为1000和2000点，提供基本的风险控制。
EA-15304.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy is a trend-following system based on the ColorXdinMA_StDev indicator, which combines a double-length smoothed moving average with standard deviation filter bands. Entry conditions operate in three modes: POINT mode triggers buy/sell when the indicator's signal buffers contain non-EMPTY_VALUE dots; DIRECT mode detects MA turning points (V-shaped reversals) by comparing three consecutive MA values; WITHOUT mode disables trading in that direction entirely. Exit conditions mirror entry with three modes - buy positions close on sell signal dots or declining MA, while sell positions close on buy signal dots or rising MA. Position sizing uses the MM parameter as a risk ratio, supporting five margin modes including fixed lot, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage calculations. The EA implements an IsNewBar check to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trades on tick-level noise. Stop loss and take profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing baseline risk control but no trailing or dynamic adjustment.

EA-15322.name: Exp_Bezier_StDev
EA-15322.summary: This EA trades based on the Bezier_StDev custom indicator, using Bezier curve smoothing with standard deviation bands to identify mean reversion entry and exit points. It supports three signal modes (point, direct, and without) for both opening and closing positions independently for buy and sell sides.
EA-15322.summary_zh: 该EA基于Bezier_StDev自定义指标进行交易，利用贝塞尔曲线平滑配合标准差通道来识别均值回归的入场和出场点。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接信号、无信号），买入和卖出方向的开仓与平仓信号可独立配置。
EA-15322.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于贝塞尔曲线平滑叠加标准差通道，属于均值回归类型。入场条件分三种模式：POINT模式通过读取指标缓冲区3（买入）和缓冲区2（卖出）的信号点判断；DIRECT模式通过判断贝塞尔曲线的拐点（V形底买入、倒V形顶卖出）确认入场；WITHOUT模式则不产生入场信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式：POINT模式读取信号点，DIRECT模式通过曲线斜率变化判断趋势反转，WITHOUT模式不平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、按余额百分比、按可用保证金百分比等。止损和止盈以点数设定，默认分别为1000和2000点。策略仅在新的K线出现时计算信号，避免重复交易，并通过IsNewBar机制控制交易频率。
EA-15322.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Bezier curve smoothing overlaid with standard deviation bands, classifying it as a mean reversion type. Entry conditions support three modes: POINT mode reads signal dots from indicator buffer 3 (buy) and buffer 2 (sell); DIRECT mode identifies Bezier curve inflection points (V-bottom for buy, inverted-V top for sell) to confirm entries; WITHOUT mode generates no entry signals. Exit conditions similarly support three modes: POINT mode reads signal dots, DIRECT mode detects trend reversal via curve slope changes, and WITHOUT mode does not close positions. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, including fixed lot, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, and others. Stop loss and take profit are set in points with defaults of 1000 and 2000 points respectively. The strategy only calculates signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trades, controlling trade frequency through the IsNewBar mechanism.

EA-15327.name: Exp_BinaryWave_StDev
EA-15327.summary: This EA trades based on the BinaryWave_StDev custom indicator, which combines seven weighted technical indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) into a composite binary wave signal with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point, direct, without) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop-loss and take-profit.
EA-15327.summary_zh: 该EA基于BinaryWave_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标将七个加权技术指标（MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI、ADX）组合成复合二值波信号并进行标准差过滤。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接信号、无信号）用于入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理及止损止盈。
EA-15327.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是将七个经典技术指标（MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、MOM、RSI、ADX）的信号通过可调权重加权合成一个复合二值波指标，再通过JJMA等平滑算法进行平滑处理，最后用标准差进行过滤以确认信号强度。入场条件分为三种模式：POINT模式通过指标缓冲区的信号点（非EMPTY_VALUE）触发；DIRECT模式通过二值波线的拐点（局部极值）触发；WITHOUT模式则不产生该方向的信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，但DIRECT模式的出场逻辑与入场不同——出场仅需二值波线方向变化即可，无需拐点确认。仓位管理支持五种模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损自由保证金、亏损余额、固定手数），通过MM参数和MMMode参数控制。止损和止盈分别固定为1000和2000点，偏差控制在10点以内。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓。
EA-15327.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy combines seven classic technical indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, MOM, RSI, ADX) through adjustable weights into a composite binary wave indicator, which is then smoothed using algorithms like JJMA and filtered by standard deviation to confirm signal strength. Entry conditions support three modes: POINT mode triggers on signal dots from indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE); DIRECT mode triggers on turning points (local extrema) of the binary wave line; WITHOUT mode disables signals for that direction. Exit conditions also support three modes, but DIRECT mode exit logic differs from entry—exits only require directional change of the binary wave line without needing turning point confirmation. Position sizing supports five modes (free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss balance, fixed lot) controlled by MM and MMMode parameters. Stop-loss and take-profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with slippage deviation controlled at 10 points. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate position openings.

EA-15328.name: Exp_ColorHMA_StDev
EA-15328.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA_StDev custom indicator, which is a Hull Moving Average with standard deviation bands. It generates buy and sell signals from indicator color changes (dot signals) or HMA direction changes, with configurable signal modes for both entry and exit independently.
EA-15328.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorHMA_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标是带标准差带的赫尔移动平均线。它通过指标颜色变化（点信号）或HMA方向变化生成买卖信号，入场和出场信号模式可独立配置。
EA-15328.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于赫尔移动平均线（HMA）配合标准差通道来判断趋势方向和波动率。入场条件有两种模式：点信号模式（POINT）检测指标缓冲区2-5中的非空值作为趋势变化信号，直接模式（DIRECT）检测HMA线的拐点或方向变化。买入开仓时，点信号模式检查缓冲区3和5（上升趋势信号），直接模式检查HMA线出现向上拐点（V形底）；卖出开仓则检查缓冲区2和4（下降趋势信号）或HMA线向下拐点。出场条件同样支持两种模式：买入平仓在点信号模式下检查卖出信号（缓冲区2和4），直接模式下检查HMA线下降；卖出平仓反之。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按余额比例、可用保证金比例或固定手数等多种资金管理模式。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，提供了较大的价格波动容错空间。策略在每个新K线或指定信号K线上进行信号判断，避免逐笔频繁交易。
EA-15328.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is based on the Hull Moving Average (HMA) combined with standard deviation channels to determine trend direction and volatility. Entry conditions come in two modes: POINT mode detects non-empty values in indicator buffers 2-5 as trend change signals, while DIRECT mode detects inflection points or direction changes in the HMA line. For buy entry in POINT mode, buffers 3 and 5 are checked (uptrend signals), and in DIRECT mode, the HMA line is checked for upward inflection (V-shaped bottom); sell entry checks buffers 2 and 4 (downtrend signals) or HMA downward inflection. Exit conditions similarly support both modes: buy close in POINT mode checks sell signals (buffers 2 and 4), and in DIRECT mode checks if HMA line is declining; sell close is the reverse. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple money management approaches including balance percentage, free margin percentage, or fixed lot size. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing substantial room for price fluctuation. The strategy evaluates signals on each new bar or the specified signal bar, avoiding excessive tick-by-tick trading.

EA-15331.name: Exp_ColorJ2JMAStDev
EA-15331.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJ2JMAStDev custom indicator, which combines a double Jurik JMA smoothing with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with multiple margin modes.
EA-15331.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJ2JMAStDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了双重Jurik JMA平滑与标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接线方向、禁用）分别控制入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理及多种保证金模式。
EA-15331.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用ColorJ2JMAStDev指标的双重Jurik JMA平滑线判断趋势方向，结合标准差乘数通道产生交易信号。入场条件支持三种模式：POINT模式通过读取指标缓冲区2-5中的点信号（非EMPTY_VALUE时触发），DIRECT模式通过JMA线的转向判断（买入需线先降后升，卖出需线先升后降），WITHOUT模式则禁用信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，DIRECT模式下买入平仓要求当前线值大于前值，卖出平仓反之。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种保证金模式包括固定手数、余额百分比等。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen等函数实现，包含止损止盈设置。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线作为信号源以避免重绘。
EA-15331.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core uses the ColorJ2JMAStDev indicator's double Jurik JMA smoothed line to determine trend direction, combined with standard deviation multiplier bands to generate trading signals. Entry conditions support three modes: POINT mode reads dot signals from indicator buffers 2-5 (triggered when not EMPTY_VALUE), DIRECT mode detects JMA line reversals (buy requires line descending then ascending, sell requires ascending then descending), and WITHOUT mode disables the signal. Exit conditions also support three modes; in DIRECT mode, buy closing requires the current line value greater than the previous value, and vice versa for sell closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk ratio, supporting five margin modes including fixed lot and balance percentage. Money management is implemented via TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions such as BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen with stop loss and take profit settings. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 meaning the previous closed bar as the signal source to avoid repainting issues.

EA-15336.name: Exp_AroonHornSign
EA-15336.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AroonHornSign indicator, opening buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on opposite signals. The EA processes signals on new bar formation and uses a static recount mechanism for reliability.
EA-15336.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AroonHornSign指标的信号进行交易，在上涨信号时开多仓，下跌信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈以及反向信号平仓功能。EA在新K线形成时处理信号，并使用静态重算机制确保可靠性。
EA-15336.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于AroonHornSign指标产生的动量信号进行交易。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区(UpValue)在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓；当指标下轨缓冲区(DnValue)产生非零且非空值时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号的平仓机制——当同时启用开仓和平仓但当前没有平仓信号时，EA会向前搜索历史柱以寻找更早的反向信号。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按损失后自由保证金比例、按损失后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理采用包含TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化算法，通过BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数执行交易操作。
EA-15336.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum signals generated by the AroonHornSign indicator. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar, a buy open and sell close are triggered; when the lower buffer (DnValue) produces a non-zero, non-empty value, a sell open and buy close are triggered. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit settings, plus an opposite-signal closing mechanism — when both open and close are enabled but no close signal exists on the current bar, the EA searches forward through historical bars to find an earlier opposite signal. Position sizing supports five modes via the MMMode parameter: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by loss-adjusted free margin, by loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses standardized algorithms from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, executing trades through BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions.

EA-15412.name: Multicurrency trading panel (mult_panel.mq5)
EA-15412.summary: A multicurrency trading panel for EURUSD, USDJPY, and GBPUSD that provides manual BUY/SELL/CLOSE buttons and an auto-trader mode. The auto-trader generates buy/sell signals by comparing the current and previous bar's Open, High, Low, and Close prices across 7 checks, then opens or reverses positions based on the signal majority. Lot sizes are adjustable per symbol via plus/minus buttons on the panel.
EA-15412.summary_zh: 一个多货币交易面板，支持EURUSD、USDJPY和GBPUSD三个品种，提供手动买入/卖出/平仓按钮以及自动交易模式。自动交易器通过比较当前K线与前一根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价共7项检查来生成买卖信号，并根据信号多数派开仓或反转仓位。每个品种的仓位大小可通过面板上的加减按钮调整。
EA-15412.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于多价格维度比较的简单动量信号：将当前K线与前一根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价、(最高+最低)/2、(最高+最低+收盘)/3、(最高+最低+收盘+收盘)/4逐一比较，7项中多数上涨则产生买入信号，多数下跌则产生卖出信号。入场条件为自动交易模式下信号方向的票数超过对方，若无持仓则直接开仓，若有反向持仓则先平仓再反转开仓。出场条件仅依赖用户手动点击CLOSE按钮或CLOSE ALL按钮，以及自动交易模式下的反向信号反转平仓。仓位管理方面，每个品种独立设置手数，初始0.01手，可通过面板加减0.01手，最低限制0.01手。资金管理方面完全没有止损止盈设置，所有开仓的SL和TP参数均为0，存在极大风险敞口。
EA-15412.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a simple momentum signal derived from multi-price-dimension comparison: it compares the current bar's Open, High, Low, Close, (High+Low)/2, (High+Low+Close)/3, and (High+Low+Close+Close)/4 against the previous bar's values across 7 checks, generating a BUY signal when the majority are rising and a SELL signal when the majority are falling. Entry conditions require the auto-trader to be enabled; if no position exists, it opens a new position in the signal direction, and if an opposing position exists, it closes and reverses. Exit conditions rely solely on manual CLOSE/CLOSE ALL button presses or automatic reversal when the auto-trader detects an opposing signal. Position sizing is managed per symbol with an initial 0.01 lot, adjustable via panel plus/minus buttons in 0.01 increments with a floor of 0.01. Money management is critically absent — all trade operations use SL=0 and TP=0, creating unlimited risk exposure with no protective stops.

pros: 多品种同时监控和交易，分散单一品种风险
提供手动和自动两种交易模式，灵活性较高
面板界面直观，操作按钮齐全，用户体验友好
pros_en: Monitors and trades multiple symbols simultaneously, diversifying single-symbol risk
Offers both manual and automated trading modes for flexibility
Intuitive panel interface with comprehensive buttons for user-friendly operation
cons: 所有交易均无止损止盈，风险敞口无限
信号逻辑过于简单，仅基于2根K线的价格比较，缺乏过滤条件
自动交易模式下每次tick都检查信号，频繁开平仓易造成过度交易
硬编码三个品种，无法自定义交易品种列表
手数调整精度为0.01，无法适配不同品种的最小手数要求
cons_en: All trades have zero stop-loss and take-profit, creating unlimited risk exposure
Signal logic is overly simplistic, based only on 2-bar price comparison with no filtering
Auto-trader checks signals every tick, leading to potential overtrading with frequent open/close cycles
Three trading symbols are hardcoded with no ability to customize the symbol list
Lot increment is fixed at 0.01 regardless of each symbol's minimum lot size requirements
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，为每笔交易设置保护性止损
增加信号过滤机制，如趋势确认指标或最小信号强度阈值，减少虚假信号
添加新K线检测逻辑，避免同一根K线内重复交易
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters to set protective stops for every trade
Implement signal filtering mechanisms such as trend confirmation indicators or minimum signal strength thresholds to reduce false signals
Add new bar detection logic to prevent repeated trading within the same bar

risk_points: 所有开仓均无止损止盈，亏损可能无限扩大
自动交易模式每次tick都评估信号，无新K线过滤，极易过度交易
反转交易先平仓再开仓，存在滑点和执行失败风险
risk_points_en: All positions open with zero SL/TP, allowing unlimited loss expansion
Auto-trader evaluates signals on every tick without new bar filtering,极易导致过度交易
Reversal trades close then open, exposing to slippage and execution failure risk
